arcs.title: Romance Dawn
arcs.description: Monkey D. Luffy sets out on an adventure to form a crew, find the legendary One Piece, and become the pirate king.

episodes.label: Romance Dawn 01
episodes.title: Romance Dawn, the Dawn of an Adventure
episodes.description: Influenced by the straw-hat-wearing pirate Red-Haired Shanks, an enthusiastic young boy named Monkey D. Luffy dreams of one day becoming King of the Pirates.

files.path: [One Pace][1-7] Romance Dawn [1080p]/[One Pace][1] Romance Dawn 01 [1080p][E5F09F49].mkv

episodes.label: Romance Dawn 02
episodes.title: They Call Him "Straw Hat" Luffy
episodes.description: While Alvida and her pirates plunder a cruise ship, they come across a barrel containing a strange boy named Monkey D. Luffy. The timid Koby befriends Luffy, and they share their grand dreams with each other.

files.path: [One Pace][1-7] Romance Dawn [1080p]/[One Pace][2] Romance Dawn 02 [1080p][A465972A].mkv

episodes.label: Romance Dawn 03
episodes.title: The Pirate King and the Master Swordsman
episodes.description: In search of members for his pirate crew, Luffy with his new friend Koby arrive at Shells Town. There, they track down the renowned Pirate Hunter Zoro but run afoul of Helmeppo, son of the infamous Captain Morgan.

files.path: [One Pace][1-7] Romance Dawn [1080p]/[One Pace][3-5] Romance Dawn 03 [1080p][2DEB2701].mkv

episodes.label: Romance Dawn 04
episodes.title: The First
episodes.description: Luffy convinces the captive Zoro to join his pirate crew, but they must first defeat the tyrannical Captain Morgan.

files.path: [One Pace][1-7] Romance Dawn [1080p]/[One Pace][5-7] Romance Dawn 04 [1080p][6E46167D].mkv

arcs.title: Orange Town
arcs.description: Luffy and Zoro run afoul of a flashy crew of pirates and their captain, Buggy the Clown. They are joined by a young girl named Nami who helps them navigate this predicament.

episodes.label: Orange Town 01
episodes.title: Enter: Nami
episodes.description: Nami, a street-smart girl who loves money and tangerines, makes Luffy's acquaintance. To save herself and steal a map to the Grand Line, she tricks Luffy into allowing her to turn him over to the infamous pirate Buggy the Clown.

files.path: [One Pace][8-21] Orange Town [1080p]/[One Pace][8-11] Orange Town 01 [1080p][CBFE01C7].mkv

episodes.label: Orange Town 02
episodes.title: Treasure
episodes.description: Luffy meets a small dog guarding his late master’s store. Meanwhile, Beast Tamer Mohji, Cabaji the Acrobat, and the lion Richie show up in the streets of Orange Town to get revenge for Captain Buggy's humiliating loss.

files.path: [One Pace][8-21] Orange Town [1080p]/[One Pace][12-19] Orange Town 02 [1080p][FAFCDE38].mkv

episodes.label: Orange Town 03
episodes.title: Pirate Buggy "the Clown"
episodes.description: Shockingly, it turns out Captain Buggy and Red-Haired Shanks share a common history. When the bombastic clown rips Shanks' straw hat, Luffy's rage knows no bounds.

files.path: [One Pace][8-21] Orange Town [1080p]/[One Pace][19-21] Orange Town 03 [1080p][9C115EE6].mkv

arcs.title: Syrup Village
arcs.description: Luffy's fledgling pirate crew arrives at the slopes of Syrup Village. There they find a liar and a conspiracy to steal a young lady's fortune.

episodes.label: Syrup Village 01
episodes.title: Captain Usopp
episodes.description: With Nami joining as Luffy's navigator (though not as an actual member of the crew), they arrive at Syrup Village in search of a proper ship. There they meet a man claiming to be a pirate captain who also seems to have ties to Red-Haired Shanks.

files.path: [One Pace][23-41] Syrup Village [1080p]/[One Pace][23-25] Syrup Village 01 [1080p][9BC8F913].mkv

episodes.label: Syrup Village 02
episodes.title: Captain Kuro
episodes.description: After uncovering a devious plot, Usopp warns the village and Kaya, but finds his years of lying make it difficult to convince people of the truth.

files.path: [One Pace][23-41] Syrup Village [1080p]/[One Pace][26-27] Syrup Village 02 [1080p][25913BDA].mkv

episodes.label: Syrup Village 03
episodes.title: The Slope
episodes.description: Usopp resolves that if he is to keep the peace, the town must continue to believe he is a liar, which means he cannot let Captain Kuro’s men up the slope to the village! Luffy, Zoro, and Nami aid Usopp in his plan to keep the Black Cat Pirates at bay.

files.path: [One Pace][23-41] Syrup Village [1080p]/[One Pace][28-30] Syrup Village 03 [1080p][F66FB414].mkv

episodes.label: Syrup Village 04
episodes.title: The Silent Man
episodes.description: Captain Kuro makes his appearance, and with Zoro too injured to fight, Luffy incapacitated, and Usopp and Nami too weak to make a stand, the situation is desperate. However, Kaya herself arrives, intent on bargaining with Kuro.

files.path: [One Pace][23-41] Syrup Village [1080p]/[One Pace][31-34] Syrup Village 04 [1080p][A5E4EBC0].mkv

episodes.label: Syrup Village 05
episodes.title: The Pirate "Kuro of a Hundred Plans"
episodes.description: While the fight between Luffy and Kuro continues, Jango works to force Kaya to bequeath her family's money to the Black Cat captain. Despite the Usopp Pirates' efforts to stop the hypnotist, it seems as if the transaction is all but inevitable.

files.path: [One Pace][23-41] Syrup Village [1080p]/[One Pace][35-37] Syrup Village 05 [1080p][707146C8].mkv

episodes.label: Syrup Village 06
episodes.title: For Whom the Bell Tolls
episodes.description: Kuro's ultimate move attacks everything in the area, friend nor foe notwithstanding, and Luffy becomes enraged by Kuro's lack of regard for his crew.

files.path: [One Pace][23-41] Syrup Village [1080p]/[One Pace][38-39] Syrup Village 06 [1080p][014834ED].mkv

episodes.label: Syrup Village 07
episodes.title: To the Sea
episodes.description: The island is saved without any villagers ever knowing what almost befell their home. Kaya, grateful to the Straw Hats for what they did, gifts them something invaluable for sailing the high seas. Meanwhile, one more person joins Luffy's crew.

files.path: [One Pace][23-41] Syrup Village [1080p]/[One Pace][40-41] Syrup Village 07 [1080p][1B7544F3].mkv

arcs.title: Gaimon
arcs.description: With Usopp now on the crew and their new ship, the Going Merry, under their command, the Straw Hats head to an island said to hold a fabled treasure. There they encounter a strange man stuck in a box who has been looking for the same treasure.

episodes.label: Gaimon 01
episodes.title: You're the Weird Animal
episodes.description: With Usopp now on the crew and their new ship, the Going Merry, under their command, the Straw Hats head to an island said to hold a fabled treasure. There they encounter a strange man stuck in a box who has been looking for the same treasure.

arcs.title: Baratie
arcs.description: The Straw Hats head to the ocean-going restaurant, Baratie, with the hopes of recruiting one of their cooks. In the meantime, hungry yet powerful forces gather to lay siege to the restaurant — all while a menacing swordsman from the Grand Line steadily approaches.

episodes.label: Baratie 01
episodes.title: Enter: Sanji
episodes.description: The Straw Hats happen across Zoro's former partners, Yosaku and Johnny, whose dietary dilemma reminds the pirates they still need a cook on their ship. Thus, they set sail for the sea restaurant Baratie, hoping to snag a chef.

episodes.label: Baratie 02
episodes.title: Pirate Commodore Don Krieg
episodes.description: Luffy is on hiatus from pirating to work as a cabin boy to pay off the damage done to the Baratie. While he tries to convince Sanji to join his crew, the pirate Gin brings the infamous Don Krieg and his starving forces to the sea restaurant.

episodes.label: Baratie 03
episodes.title: The Oath
episodes.description: As Nami steals the Going Merry, Hawk-Eye Mihawk, known far and wide as the world's greatest swordsman, arrives all the way from the Grand Line to finish off Don Krieg. However, Zoro challenges the deadly Mihawk to a duel in order to achieve his dream.

episodes.label: Baratie 04
episodes.title: Pearl
episodes.description: Mihawk departs after defeating Zoro, and Krieg continues his assault on the Baratie. Pearl, one of Krieg's strongest men, goes on the offensive with fiery attacks and multiple shields at his disposal, so Sanji reveals his unique fighting style.

episodes.label: Baratie 05
episodes.title: Because of a Dream
episodes.description: Sanji continues to battle Pearl, but Gin cleverly holds Chef Zeff hostage, forcing Sanji an impossible situation. Sanji's childhood memories flood his mind, and he reflects on why Zeff means so much to him.

episodes.label: Baratie 06
episodes.title: MH5
episodes.description: In a surprising twist, Gin finishes Pearl off himself, claiming Sanji as his own target. Though still wounded, Sanji rises to the challenge and faces off with Gin. As the battle draws to a close, Don Krieg unleashes a deadly toxin into the air.

episodes.label: Baratie 07
episodes.title: The Stalwart War Spear
episodes.description: The struggle with Krieg nears its end. Luffy's fighting spirit is unwavering, even after taking several hits from Krieg's Stalwart War Spear. Straw Hat’s strategy shifts to smashing through Krieg’s defenses and attacking the spear head-on.

episodes.label: Baratie 08
episodes.title: The Fourth
episodes.description: As the dust of battle settles, the still poisoned Gin decides to go back to the Grand Line with Krieg, and Sanji makes the difficult decision to join Luffy's crew. Suddenly, Yosaku returns with news of where Nami took the Going Merry.

arcs.title: Arlong Park
arcs.description: Nami's hometown has long been overrun by Arlong and his band of fishmen from the Grand Line. When the Straw Hats arrive, they find that their prospective navigator has left out a few key details about herself.

episodes.label: Arlong Park 01
episodes.title: Arlong Park
episodes.description: As they depart the Baratie in pursuit of Nami and the Going Merry, Yosaku warns Luffy and Sanji about the vicious Arlong and his fishman underlings. Meanwhile, Usopp, Johnny, and Zoro make landfall where Nami docked the Merry.

episodes.label: Arlong Park 02
episodes.title: Monsters of the Grand Line
episodes.description: Usopp, having challenged the fishmen, has been caught. To effectively prove her loyalty to the Arlong Pirates, Nami is left with a morbid choice.

episodes.label: Arlong Park 03
episodes.title: Sea Charts and Fishmen
episodes.description: Luffy’s group has reached the island but are met with a shocking revelation. Unmoved by Nami’s apparent actions and her insistence that he leaves, Luffy stubbornly sticks around.

episodes.label: Arlong Park 04
episodes.title: Bell-mère
episodes.description: Nojiko goes into detail about Nami's childhood and their adoptive mother Bell-mère, a former Marine. Despite being poor and unrelated by blood, they had a happy life on their tangerine orchard.

episodes.label: Arlong Park 05
episodes.title: Live
episodes.description: When a Marine officer under Arlong's pay confiscates all the money Nami accumulated over the years, it becomes clear where Arlong stands on his promise.

episodes.label: Arlong Park 06
episodes.title: OK, LET'S STAND UP
episodes.description: Nami's audible sorrows have reached the ears of a certain Straw Hat captain, and he and his crew rise to action. The villagers look on in awe as the Straw Hats boldly enter Arlong Park to face the fishmen.

episodes.label: Arlong Park 07
episodes.title: Chivalry vs. Fishman Karate
episodes.description: Luffy’s newest move leaves him incapacitated and at the mercy of the sea while Zoro, Sanji, and Usopp desperately fight off Arlong’s top officers.

episodes.label: Arlong Park 08
episodes.title: My Turn
episodes.description: The top officers are defeated, but as they currently are, Sanji and Zoro prove to be no match for Arlong. However, with Luffy finally free, he just may just be able to pull it off. Meanwhile, Nami finally gathers the courage to face Arlong.

episodes.label: Arlong Park 09
episodes.title: The Second
episodes.description: Luffy springs into action against Arlong, and their intense struggle commences! Luffy becomes enraged when he discovers how exactly Arlong had been using Nami, and he comes to a quick decision on how to finally free her of her shackles.

episodes.label: Arlong Park 10
episodes.title: Spin, Pinwheel, Spin
episodes.description: Arlong's reign of terror is over, so the island throws a party to celebrate their freedom and to honor their pirate saviors. During the festivities, Nami makes her decision to officially join the Straw Hat Pirates.

arcs.title: The Adventures of Buggy's Crew
arcs.description: Buggy, after being defeated by Luffy, Zoro, and Nami, begins his quest to regain his body parts and his crew, and then he will get his flashy revenge on Luffy.

episodes.label: The Adventures of Buggy's Crew
episodes.title: The Adventures of Buggy's Crew
episodes.description: Buggy, after being defeated by Luffy, Zoro, and Nami, begins his quest to regain his body parts and his crew, and then he will get his flashy revenge on Luffy.

files.path: [One Pace][35-75] The Adventures of Buggy's Crew [1080p][1177A2B6].mkv

arcs.title: Loguetown
arcs.description: The final island before entering the Grand Line: Loguetown. Luffy and his crew drop anchor to stock up, sightsee, and pay their respects to the place where Gold Roger drew his last breath.

episodes.label: Loguetown 01
episodes.title: The Town of Beginnings and Endings
episodes.description: Touting a fresh bounty issued by Marine HQ, Luffy and co. make landfall at Loguetown, the place where Gold Roger was both born and executed. Being the last stop before the Grand Line, the crew stocks up on supplies and sightsees.

episodes.label: Loguetown 02
episodes.title: Parallels
episodes.description: Usopp manages to anger the brat daughter of bounty hunter Daddy the Father and finds his own life at stake. When Daddy discovers that Usopp is the son of Red Hair Pirate Yasopp, the only man to beat him, he offers him a risky way out.

episodes.label: Loguetown 03
episodes.title: The Legend Has Begun
episodes.description: Luffy arrives at the execution platform, only to be caught in Buggy and Alvida's trap. Sanji and Zoro rush to stop Buggy from poetically—and flashily—executing Luffy where Roger died.

arcs.title: Reverse Mountain
arcs.description: Reverse Mountain is the entrance to the Grand Line. What await the Straw Hats are impossible water currents, a giant whale, and dubious people going by codenames.

episodes.label: Reverse Mountain 01
episodes.title: Reverse Mountain
episodes.description: Following a near disaster in the Calm Belt, the Straw Hats take a wild ride up and down a mountain… and are promptly swallowed by a giant whale!

episodes.label: Reverse Mountain 02
episodes.title: Cape Promise
episodes.description: After learning of Laboon the whale's plight, Luffy comes up with a solution befitting his style. As thanks, Crocus reveals that navigating the Grand Line will not be as simple as following a compass or relying on currents and wind.

arcs.title: Whisky Peak
arcs.description: The first island on the Grand Line is surprisingly welcoming to pirates. But as night falls, a deadly plot unravels.

episodes.label: Whisky Peak 01
episodes.title: The Town of Welcome
episodes.description: As the Straw Hat Pirates travel from Reverse Mountain to Whisky Peak, Nami adjusts to having to watch the log pose constantly. When they arrive at their destination, the townspeople greet them warmly, despite the sight of their Jolly Roger.

files.path: [One Pace][106-114] Whiskey Peak [480p]/[One Pace][106-109] Whiskey Peak 01 [480p][26D6F22A].mkv

episodes.label: Whisky Peak 02
episodes.title: The Secret Criminal Organization
episodes.description: As Mr. 5 and Miss Valentine chase after the fleeing princess Vivi, Igaram begs Zoro to save her. But just when Zoro is about to take on Vivi's assailants, an enraged Luffy confronts him under a massive misunderstanding of the swordsman's latest actions.

files.path: [One Pace][106-114] Whiskey Peak [480p]/[One Pace][110-114] Whiskey Peak 02 [480p][3677DB27].mkv

arcs.title: The Trials of Koby-Meppo
arcs.description: Koby and Helmeppo are new cabin boys for the marines, but they become unwillingly involved in an escape attempt by Morgan. Their bravery will either earn them the respect of their superiors—as well as Vice Admiral Garp—or it will spell their doom.

episodes.label: The Trials of Koby-Meppo
episodes.title: The Trials of Koby-Meppo
episodes.description: Koby and Helmeppo are new cabin boys for the Marines, but they become unwillingly involved in an escape attempt by Morgan. Their bravery will either earn them the respect of their superiors—as well as Vice Admiral Garp—or it will spell their doom.

arcs.title: Little Garden
arcs.description: The Straw Hats vow to bring Princess Vivi to Arabasta, and their journey brings them to Little Garden, an island from prehistoria that is home to creatures and people larger than life.

episodes.label: Little Garden 01
episodes.title: Adventure on Little Garden
episodes.description: The Straw Hats arrive at their destination and discover that the island is home to enormous creatures... and people. Meanwhile, the Baroque Works agents Mr. 3 and his partner Miss Golden Week receive new orders.

episodes.label: Little Garden 02
episodes.title: Dorry and Brogy
episodes.description: Usopp, immensely impressed with the giants of Elbaph, names Brogy his master. To commemorate their duel, the giants imbibe two barrels of booze from Nami, but, unbeknownst to anyone, a saboteur has tampered with one of them!

episodes.label: Little Garden 03
episodes.title: Foul Play
episodes.description: Despite his internal injuries and Luffy's warnings, the prideful giant Dorry insists on continuing his duel with Brogy. Meanwhile, the Baroque Works officer agents begin to make their move on the island with the Straw Hats as their next targets.

episodes.label: Little Garden 04
episodes.title: Luffy vs. Mr. 3
episodes.description: Luffy, Usopp, and Karoo launch headlong into rescuing their friends, but Miss Golden Week runs a colorful interference. Mr. 3 is forced to take matters into his own conniving hands, and Usopp brainstorms how he will finally free his friends.

episodes.label: Little Garden 05
episodes.title: Straight Ahead!!
episodes.description: Sanji, pretending to be Mr. 3, convinces Crocodile he has eliminated Vivi and co., prompting the Unluckies to arrive and deliver a way off Little Garden. With a clear path straight ahead—or so it seems—the Straw Hats set sail.

arcs.title: Drum Island
arcs.description: When Nami falls ill, the crew makes a detour from Arabasta to seek medical help. They happen upon a winter island inhabited by a distrusting populace and a single doctor with a mysterious reindeer companion.

episodes.label: Drum Island 01
episodes.title: Tin Plate Wapol
episodes.description: En route to Arabasta, Nami falls ill. Without a doctor aboard the Going Merry, the Straw Hats must decide whether to stay the course or find more immediate help. As their ship crosses into a frigid area, a figure is seen standing on the water's surface.

episodes.label: Drum Island 02
episodes.title: Adventure in a Nameless Country
episodes.description: If the Straw Hats have any chance of saving Nami, they must carry her up a mountain to see the sole doctor of a nameless, winter island. While Sanji and Luffy fight off the wilderness, a despicable king makes an unwanted return.

episodes.label: Drum Island 03
episodes.title: The Summit
episodes.description: A devastating avalanche sweeps Drum Island and puts everyone at risk, but Luffy—step-by-step, hand-over-hand—continues his death-defying ascent up the mountain. Meanwhile, Vivi, Usopp, and Zoro reunite in the wake of the disaster.

episodes.label: Drum Island 04
episodes.title: Enter: Tony Tony Chopper
episodes.description: Enter Chopper: a talking, transforming blue-nosed reindeer who was trained by Dr. Kureha in medicine. The Straw Hats immediately see the positives and want him on their crew, but Chopper must first deal with the monstrous pain in his heart.

episodes.label: Drum Island 05
episodes.title: Quack Doctor
episodes.description: Chopper began life as an ordinary reindeer but was shunned by his own kind because of his unusual blue nose. Even after eating the Human-Human Devil Fruit, the islanders wanted nothing to do with him. That is, until Chopper met a certain quack doctor.

episodes.label: Drum Island 06
episodes.title: Unbreakable
episodes.description: Wapol and his comrades reach the mountaintop castle to wrest control of it back from Dr. Kureha and Chopper. Luffy, Sanji, and Chopper go head-to-head against his Munch-Munch powers, vowing to keep Wapol and his men from bringing down Hiriluk's flag.

episodes.label: Drum Island 07
episodes.title: The Skies of Drum
episodes.description: Chopper counters the combined Chessmarimo with an item that expands his zoan fruit abilities. Wapol slips away into his old castle, but Luffy runs after him to force a final showdown.

episodes.label: Drum Island 08
episodes.title: Hiriluk's Cherry Blossoms
episodes.description: Finally convinced to join the Straw Hat Pirates, Chopper announces his intentions to Dr. Kureha. While she doesn’t receive the news well at first, she decides to give the Straw Hats a fond parting gift while they exit the island.

arcs.title: Alabasta
arcs.description: Arabasta teeters on the edge of civil war, and it's up to Princess Vivi and the Straw Hats to stem the rebellion, uncover the plot of Baroque Works, and beat the Warlord Crocodile.

episodes.label: Alabasta 01
episodes.title: Sir Crocodile, the Pirate
episodes.description: In Arabasta, the hero Crocodile appears and puts a decisive end to a pillaging band of pirates. Meanwhile, Mr. 2 Bon Kurei pays a visit to the newly arrived Straw Hats. When he puts his abilities on display, Vivi notices something shocking.

episodes.label: Alabasta 02
episodes.title: Landfall in Alabasta
episodes.description: The Merry makes landfall at Arabasta’s port town, and while the rest of the Straw Hats wisely don disguises, Luffy runs afoul of an old foe. However, a chance reunion with a flame-wielding member of Luffy’s family might just be the saving grace he needs!

episodes.label: Alabasta 03
episodes.title: Adventure in the Kingdom of Sand
episodes.description: The Straw Hats finally start their arduous trek across the deserts of Arabasta! Along the way, they encounter martial-arts-loving dugongs, avian con artists, a giant carnivorous reptile, and a camel with very particular tastes in his passengers.

episodes.label: Alabasta 04
episodes.title: Yuba, the Town of Rebels
episodes.description: Vivi and co. finally reach Yuba, the last known location of the Rebel Army, but there is nary a soul in sight. Meanwhile, at the behest of their hidden leader, Baroque Works' officer agents begin to gather at the Spiders Cafe.

episodes.label: Alabasta 05
episodes.title: I Love My Country
episodes.description: At Rain Dinners, the Baroque Works officer agents are finally let on to Mr. 0's true identity. And just outside Yuba, Luffy confronts a stubborn Vivi to remind her who else is willing to stand with her.

episodes.label: Alabasta 06
episodes.title: Rainbase, the City of Dreams
episodes.description: Luffy's band reaches the city of Rainbase but encounter Smoker and Tashigi. As they defend themselves against both the Marines and Baroque Works' millions, Luffy's party storms Crocodile's Rain Dinners Casino.

episodes.label: Alabasta 07
episodes.title: It Begins
episodes.description: Luffy leads a daring—but foolish—raid on Crocodile’s casino. His poor planning lands him behind bars with Captain Smoker. But more importantly, these actions leave Vivi alone and unprotected.

episodes.label: Alabasta 08
episodes.title: Rebellion
episodes.description: “The king of Arabasta” appears to order Nanohana’s attack. With this, the people's anger explodes! Meanwhile, Vivi frantically looks for Sanji, and as Crocodile leaves the pirates to their fate, he is suddenly contacted by a "Mr. Prince."

episodes.label: Alabasta 09
episodes.title: Rush!!
episodes.description: Thanks to Sanji's brave actions, the Straw Hats made their escape, and Captain Smoker graciously looks the other way as they flee. However, as they set out toward Alubarna, Crocodile waylays Luffy, and the two begin a vicious duel.

episodes.label: Alabasta 10
episodes.title: Showdown at Alubarna
episodes.description: Vivi’s party speeds along toward Alubarna, as does the Rebel Army. While the Supersonic Duck Squad helps Zoro and the others play decoy, Vivi sets out on her own to try and stop Koza and his rebels.

episodes.label: Alabasta 11
episodes.title: Molehill Zone Four
episodes.description: Despite his severe injuries, Karoo picks up Vivi to flee the attacks of Mr. 2, and they dash madly through the battlefield. And at the southeast gate: Chopper and Usopp vs. Mr. 4 and Miss Merry Christmas!

episodes.label: Alabasta 12
episodes.title: Okama Kenpo
episodes.description: Usopp and Chopper combine their skills to finish off Mr. 4 and Miss Merry Christmas, and Sanji engages Mr. 2 in a vicious foot-to-foot struggle. Meanwhile, as a last-ditch effort to save her people, Princess Vivi gives Chaka an unprecedented order.

episodes.label: Alabasta 13
episodes.title: She Who Controls the Weather
episodes.description: Nami combats Miss Doublefinger, whose Spike-Spike powers quickly turn their brawl into a losing battle. That is, until Usopp's invention, the Climate Baton, gives Nami a fighting chance. And at the palace, Crocodile reveals his ultimate goal.

episodes.label: Alabasta 14
episodes.title: Cutting Steel
episodes.description: Crocodile reveals he seeks the mysterious Pluton, Nami has one last chance to stop Miss Doublefinger, and Zoro struggles against Mr. 1. As Zoro confronts certain death, he must remember something his sensei once imparted.

episodes.label: Alabasta 15
episodes.title: The Leaders
episodes.description: Vivi reveals Crocodile's heinous plan to Koza. To stop the fighting, Koza raises the white flag but is suddenly shot. To induce even more panic, Crocodile announces that a massive bomb will be launched into the city, and he drops Vivi to her doom.

episodes.label: Alabasta 16
episodes.title: HOPE!!
episodes.description: Luffy vs. Crocodile: Round 2! Luffy has discovered Crocodile’s weakness, but the power of the Sand-Sand Fruit is devastating regardless. Meanwhile, the remaining Straw Hats have ten minutes to find a hidden cannoneer before a bomb is launched into the city.

episodes.label: Alabasta 17
episodes.title: Croc-ish
episodes.description: Luffy and Crocodile enter the third phase of their duel, and, without water at his disposal, Luffy is forced to improvise. Back on the surface, Vivi uses her knowledge of the city to finally pinpoint the location of the bomb's cannoneer.

episodes.label: Alabasta 18
episodes.title: I Will Defeat You
episodes.description: Vivi finds the cannon but realizes the bomb can't be stopped so casually. Then Pell swoops in with a decisive, if tragic, solution. The final battle between Luffy and Crocodile, which has both parties driven to their utmost, reaches its conclusion.

episodes.label: Alabasta 19
episodes.title: Some Justice
episodes.description: Igaram appears with proof of Cobra's innocence, and Koza tells the people the truth behind the war. Luffy and his crew are brought into Cobra's palace to rest, and, during this time, Igaram receives word that there are new bounties making the rounds!

episodes.label: Alabasta 20
episodes.title: Vivi's Adventure
episodes.description: As the Straw Hats make their escape from Arabasta, Bon Kurei and his men serve to distract Black Cage Hina of the Marines. Meanwhile, Vivi must make a speech, but, more importantly, she must decide whether to stay with the Straw Hats.

episodes.label: Alabasta 21
episodes.title: Stowaway
episodes.description: The Straw Hats have evaded the Marines, but a new development crops up when a certain stowaway makes her presence on the Going Merry known… and she wants to be part of the crew!

arcs.title: Jaya
arcs.description: The Straw Hats seek the fabled sky island Skypiea and head to Jaya for information on its whereabouts. Their convictions are tested by the pirates of Mock Town, but not everyone on the island is a hardline skeptic.

episodes.label: Jaya 01
episodes.title: Why the Log Pose Is Spherical
episodes.description: When a galleon-size ship falls from the sky and Nami's log pose begins to point straight up, the Straw Hats sense a new adventure on the horizon. Right after a mysterious map is pulled from the wreckage, a group of salvagers come to claim the fallen ship.

episodes.label: Jaya 02
episodes.title: Never Dream
episodes.description: Mock Town on western Jaya openly welcomes pirates, but that fact is accompanied by constant danger. While asking about the sky island, Luffy and Zoro have a run-in with the loud pirate Bellamy the Hyena who ridicules their dreams.

episodes.label: Jaya 03
episodes.title: People's Dreams
episodes.description: After a one-sided brawl with Bellamy, the Straw Hats meet a black-haired pirate outside the bar who reaffirms their dreams and insists the sky island is real. As they depart for the other side of Jaya, another salvager of the Saruyama Alliance appears.

episodes.label: Jaya 04
episodes.title: Noland the Liar
episodes.description: The Straw Hats meet Montblanc Cricket, whose descendant was none other than Montblanc Noland, an infamous "liar" who told of a city of gold on Jaya. Cast out for looking for artifacts from the fabled city, he may just know a way to get to Skypiea.

episodes.label: Jaya 05
episodes.title: Let's Eat
episodes.description: Cricket explains how the Straw Hats can ride a dangerous vertical sea current to get to Skypiea. However, they must first catch a south bird to steer them toward the point where the stream will erupt from the ocean.

episodes.label: Jaya 06
episodes.title: The Hundred Million Man
episodes.description: While the Straw Hats are in the forest attempting to catch a south bird, Bellamy and his crew attack Masira, Shoujou, and Cricket and steal every gold artifact they had collected over the years from the salvage work of the Saruyama Alliance.

episodes.label: Jaya 07
episodes.title: The Highest Authority in the World
episodes.description: The duel between Bellamy and Luffy shocks all who look on. More shocking are the movements of fearsome pirates on the Grand Line and the machinations of the Blackbeard Pirates, as their captain vies for a position as a Warlord.

episodes.label: Jaya 08
episodes.title: The Knock-Up Stream
episodes.description: Luffy returns victorious from his showdown with Bellamy, and the Going Merry has been refit by the Saruyama Alliance to handle its upcoming upward flight. The Straw Hats follow their captive south bird and steel themselves for their journey to the sky.

arcs.title: Skypiea
arcs.description: Arriving at Skypiea, the Straw Hats are instantly met with unfamiliar sights, objects, and customs. What's more, the god of the sky island deems the Blue Sea dwellers to be trespassing and casts his judgment upon them.

episodes.label: Skypiea 01
episodes.title: Heaven's Gate
episodes.description: The Straw Hats, having used the Knock-Up Stream to fly into the sky, arrive on a white ocean above the clouds. While they marvel at the otherworldly sights, they are attacked by a powerful masked figure, and a mysterious flying knight comes to their aid.

episodes.label: Skypiea 02
episodes.title: Angel Beach
episodes.description: After bidding farewell to Gan Fall and passing through the gate to Skypiea, the pirates encounter a family of Skypieans: Conis and her father, Pagaya. The two explain the workings of life in the sky and introduce the crew to the different dials.

episodes.label: Skypiea 03
episodes.title: Divine Reckoning
episodes.description: Nami takes the waver out for a test ride and discovers the forbidden Upper Yard. Meanwhile, law enforcement arrives and rudely harasses the rest of the gang.

episodes.label: Skypiea 04
episodes.title: Ordeal
episodes.description: The pirates are fed up and ready to leave Skypiea, but Nami, Zoro, Robin, and Chopper are whisked away aboard the Merry. The remaining Straw Hat Pirates must face Enel’s challenge, so Conis shows them the way to Upper Yard.

episodes.label: Skypiea 05
episodes.title: Adventure on God's Island
episodes.description: Aboard the Little Crow, Luffy, Usopp, and Sanji enter Upper Yard and must choose an ordeal. Meanwhile, Zoro and co. have their own troubles at the Sacrificial Altar. When they leave to explore the forest, Chopper is left to repair the Merry.

episodes.label: Skypiea 06
episodes.title: The Village Hidden in the Clouds
episodes.description: Luffy, Sanji, and Usopp are locked in a life-or-death struggle against the Priest Satori. It's all they can do to withstand the random attributes of Satori's strange spheres and to overcome the power of mantra, which can seemingly predict their movements.

episodes.label: Skypiea 07
episodes.title: Overture
episodes.description: Gan Fall is severely burned during his battle with Shura, and Chopper musters the courage for a leap of faith. Elsewhere, Luffy and co. finally discover a way to defeat the mantra-wielding Satori, and the Shandians prepare for an all-out attack on God!

episodes.label: Skypiea 08
episodes.title: Vearth
episodes.description: The Shandians’ attack on Upper Yard commences! At the Sacrificial Altar, the crew is finally reunited, and everyone recounts what has happened. Chopper looks after the injured Gan Fall, and the pirates devise a plan to steal the gold on the island.

episodes.label: Skypiea 09
episodes.title: Dial Battle
episodes.description: The crew splits up into Nami's escape team and Luffy's exploration team. Unfortunately, a giant snake attacks and separates Luffy's team. To top it all off, the Priests have set up their ordeals across the whole island.

episodes.label: Skypiea 10
episodes.title: Pirate Luffy vs. Berserker Wyper
episodes.description: Only 80 remain in the Upper Yard survival game. Zoro finds himself face-to-face with the Shandian Braham, Luffy takes on Wyper and his burning bazooka, and Nami’s group on the Merry has the deadliest encounter of all!

episodes.label: Skypiea 11
episodes.title: Pirate Chopper vs. Priest Gedatsu
episodes.description: Luffy's fight with Wyper lands him in a dark cavern filled with ruins, Enel leaves a deadly pair of new enemies to deal with Nami and Gan Fall, and Chopper comes face to face with Sky Punk Gedatsu.

episodes.label: Skypiea 12
episodes.title: Pirate Robin vs. Commander Yama
episodes.description: Enel wipes out several fighters regardless of their allegiance. An hour remains until God's deadline, and only twenty-four survivors remain. Meanwhile, after a deadly struggle with the rotund Yama, Robin makes the discovery of a lifetime.

episodes.label: Skypiea 13
episodes.title: Concerto
episodes.description: While Luffy remains lost in a strange, dark cavern, at the Upper Ruins, Priest Ohm confronts Zoro, Gan Fall, and Wyper with his Ordeal of Iron. As the fight wears on, Shandian warriors, Nami, and Aisa make a sudden appearance.

episodes.label: Skypiea 14
episodes.title: Pirate Zoro vs. Priest Ohm
episodes.description: After being swallowed by the giant snake, Nami, Gan Fall, and Aisa meet someone they never expected would be in the serpent's stomach. As Priest Ohm’s Ordeal of Iron comes to a close in the Upper Ruins, Zoro unleashes a powerful new technique.

episodes.label: Skypiea 15
episodes.title: Quintet
episodes.description: The lost ruins of Shandora are revealed in a spectacle of lightning, and the remaining survivors of Enel's twisted game begin their showdown with the self-styled deity. As the group faces him, "God" reveals his ultimate goal...

episodes.label: Skypiea 16
episodes.title: Conis
episodes.description: God Enel reveals his grand masterpiece to the sole survivor of his deadly game, and a certain rubber man finally frees himself of the snake's stomach! Meanwhile, Conis makes a desperate dash to Angel Island to warn its residents of their impending doom.

episodes.label: Skypiea 17
episodes.title: Deathpiea
episodes.description: As the citizens of the sky run for their lives, Enel activates Deathpiea! Luffy must discover a way to lay hands on the heinous holy man before he's sent overboard, and Sanji and Usopp mount a midair rescue mission.

episodes.label: Skypiea 18
episodes.title: On the Front Line of Love's Salvation
episodes.description: Usopp arrives just in time to save Nami from a lethal thunderbolt, and Sanji stealthily searches for a way to sabotage the ark. Despite being slowed by an arm encased in gold, Luffy races up Giant Jack on a mission to settle the score!

episodes.label: Skypiea 19
episodes.title: Godkiller
episodes.description: As Enel rains destruction upon Skypiea, Wyper remembers the tales passed down by the village elder about when his ancestor the warrior Kalgara met the explorer Mont Blanc Noland.

episodes.label: Skypiea 20
episodes.title: The Light of Shandora
episodes.description: The flashback of the legend of Mont Blanc Noland and Kalgara the warrior continues with the story of how these two very different men suddenly found friendship... and then lost it just as quickly!

episodes.label: Skypiea 21
episodes.title: Raigō
episodes.description: Mont Blanc Noland's tale ends in tragedy and misunderstanding. In the present, Enel strikes Angel Island with a devastating lightning bolt, and Luffy refuses to halt his climb up the beanstalk until he rings the golden bell!

episodes.label: Skypiea 22
episodes.title: Love Song
episodes.description: While Enel continues his thunderous barrage, Nami hatches a plan to give Luffy one more shot at a grudge match with God. With a nudge from Zoro, Wyper, and a snake, Straw Hat launches himself into the center of a sinister storm!

episodes.label: Skypiea 23
episodes.title: Fantasia
episodes.description: In the aftermath of Luffy's epic battle with Enel, sunny skies chase away the storms, and the cloud-dwelling citizens of Angel Island turn their attention to rebuilding their homeland.

episodes.label: Skypiea 24
episodes.title: I Made It Here
episodes.description: Robin deciphers the message of the poneglyph, ending the Shandians' centuries-long task of guarding the golden bell. Before leaving Skypiea, the Straw Hats embark on their promised gold heist, and the people of the sky see them off on their journey.

episodes.label: Skypiea 25
episodes.title: Finale
episodes.description: With a little help from their new friends—and a giant octopus—the Straw Hats bid farewell to Skypiea and begin their descent back to the Blue Sea. Then as night falls, a certain Warlord makes an appearance at Jaya...

arcs.title: Long Ring Long Land
arcs.description: On Long Ring Long Land, the Straw Hats are challenged to a Davy Back Fight. As they dive headfirst into a series of games with serious outcomes, the best the Navy has to offer has meanwhile begun to pay closer attention to certain Straw Hat crewmembers.

episodes.label: Long Ring Long Land 01
episodes.title: Adventure on a Long Island
episodes.description: As they continue to traverse the Grand Line, the Straw Hats pass a ship with no sails, no Jolly Roger, and no captain. After an encounter with giant sea monkeys, they come upon an island where everything is much longer than usual.

episodes.title: Marine HQ Admiral Aokiji
episodes.description: Only three officers in all the Marines hold the position of admiral, literal powerhouses of the World Government. The icy Aokiji, one such admiral, catches up with the Straw Hats, but Luffy is not the one he is after.

arcs.title: Water Seven
arcs.description: The Straw Hats make landfall at the glorious city of Water Seven, known worldwide for its unparalleled shipyards. The pirates go to inquire about repairs for their ship, but the city threatens to take their money, their ship, and their crewmates.

episodes.label: Water Seven 01
episodes.title: The City of Water, Water Seven
episodes.description: The keepers of Shift Station, Kokoro and her granddaughter Chimney, point the Straw Hats in the direction of the metropolitan Water Seven. The nearby city is regarded as the best place to find a decent shipwright for the Going Merry.

episodes.label: Water Seven 02
episodes.title: Mr. Iceburg
episodes.description: The Straw Hats cash in their Skypiean gold and meet up with Iceburg, the celebrity mayor of Water Seven, to see about an appraisal for their ship's repairs. While the foreman Kaku checks the Merry, dubious people eye the pirates' money.

episodes.label: Water Seven 03
episodes.title: The Case of the Kidnapped Pirate
episodes.description: Kalifa shows Luffy and co. around Dock One and tells them about Iceburg and Galley-La Company. During the tour, Kaku returns with some bad news, and a long-nosed Straw Hat goes missing… along with the money he was watching!

episodes.label: Water Seven 04
episodes.title: Impasse
episodes.description: The Straw Hats raid the Franky House, but they soon find that their real target, Franky, is long gone with the stolen money. When the battered Usopp awakens, nothing can prepare him to hear what Luffy has decided about the Merry.

episodes.label: Water Seven 05
episodes.title: Luffy vs. Usopp
episodes.description: Usopp is unwilling to say farewell to the Going Merry… not without a fight, that is! He challenges his former captain to a duel between men, so Luffy honors the pride of his former crewmate and faces him in battle.

episodes.label: Water Seven 06
episodes.title: Warning
episodes.description: Iceburg has been shot! When Luffy and Nami decide to go check on him, the fire-breathing, half-mechanical Franky challenges the Straw Hats’ captain. Before their fight gets too heated, Galley-La swoops in with an unexpected accusation!

episodes.label: Water Seven 07
episodes.title: Rumors
episodes.description: Things are hectic enough with Franky going after Luffy, but now the Straw Hats are being framed for a crime seemingly committed by Nico Robin. As if to put the proverbial icing on the cake, the annual storm Aqua Laguna is on its way toward Water Seven.

episodes.label: Water Seven 08
episodes.title: Devil
episodes.description: Nico Robin appears to be working alongside a World Government shadow organization called CP9. When the Straw Hats learn about Robin's current affiliation, Luffy decides that in order to know the full truth, they must catch Robin and make her talk.

episodes.label: Water Seven 09
episodes.title: Cipher Pol No. 9
episodes.description: Robin and her tall, mysterious, masked companion arrive at Iceburg's room, and she learns that he possesses blueprints to the ancient weapon Pluton, spoken of in the poneglyphs. Then, shockingly, the members of CP9 unmask themselves.

episodes.label: Water Seven 10
episodes.title: Six Powers
episodes.description: Luffy's group finally catches up to Robin, but they are greeted by disappointment—Robin opts to stay with CP9 and leave the Straw Hats. As Robin turns away from Luffy, the members of CP9 confronts the pirates.

episodes.label: Water Seven 11
episodes.title: Klabautermann
episodes.description: As Usopp works to repair the Going Merry, he contends with Franky's insistence on dismantling it. During this time, Usopp reflects on who it was that conducted the ship's repairs while in Skypiea, and Franky confirms his suspicions.

episodes.label: Water Seven 12
episodes.title: The Legendary Shipwright
episodes.description: In the past, Franky—a.k.a. Cutty Flam—was part of the legendary Tom's Workers, and he and Iceburg helped create the sea train. Spandam, a member of CP5, was determined to get Tom's blueprints for Pluton by any means necessary.

episodes.label: Water Seven 13
episodes.title: Mr. Tom
episodes.description: The old fishman Tom was framed by CP5 for the crime of attacking the Marines with Franky's battleships. As the World Government hauled Tom off to Enies Lobby, Franky received a lasting reminder to take pride in the ships he builds.

episodes.label: Water Seven 14
episodes.title: Bingo
episodes.description: CP9 hauls away Franky and Usopp, but not before giving a coldhearted farewell to the Merry. At Galley-La’s HQ, Nami learns from Iceburg the truth behind Robin's betrayal and the difficult choice she had to make to save the lives of the Straw Hats.

episodes.label: Water Seven 15
episodes.title: Departing Shortly
episodes.description: While the members of Galley-La help Chopper search for Luffy and Zoro, Nami rushes to the departing sea train to keep Robin from sacrificing her freedom. At the station, a man finds Nami and hands her a letter from Sanji.

episodes.label: Water Seven 16
episodes.title: Aqua Laguna
episodes.description: Sanji coolly fights his way through the sea train and locates Usopp and Franky. Back in Water Seven, Kokoro sees how determined Luffy is to save Robin, so she and Iceburg lend the Straw Hat crew an unexpected helping hand.

episodes.label: Water Seven 17
episodes.title: Sogeking
episodes.description: Rocketman blasts out of Water Seven and connects with the sea tracks, and old foes become allies for the coming struggle. Aqua Laguna swells, and it's up to Luffy and Zoro to combine their might and create safe passage for all aboard.

episodes.label: Water Seven 18
episodes.title: Ramen Kenpo
episodes.description: Sogeking appears in grand fashion! Wanze threatens Sanji's group with his ramen kenpo, so the Straw Hat cook urges the others ahead. Franky takes on CP9's newest recruit “Sea Weasel” Nero, and Sogeking moves forward to meet up with Robin.

episodes.label: Water Seven 19
episodes.title: The Honorable Captain T-Bone
episodes.description: In his battle against Wanze and his strange Ramen Kenpo, Sanji makes an exception to his rule of never using his hands. Meanwhile, Franky and Nero are baffled by each other’s abilities, and back on Rocketman, Zoro clashes with “Ship-Slasher” T-Bone.

episodes.label: Water Seven 20
episodes.title: Necessary Evil
episodes.description: Sanji and Franky conclude their fights and enter the train car where CP9’s agents lie in wait. When Sogeking sees the danger of the situation, it falls to him to formulate a plan for escape. However, CP9 is far from being thwarted!

arcs.title: Enies Lobby
arcs.description: In order to free Nico Robin from the clutches of the World Government, the Straw Hats and their allies must invade the judicial island, Enies Lobby, and take on the government's premiere clandestine unit: CP9.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 01
episodes.title: The Superhumans of Enies Lobby
episodes.description: As the Straw Hats and their allies approach Enies Lobby on Rocketman, they hatch a plan to save Robin before she passes through the Gates of Justice. Meanwhile, Spandam holds a meeting with CP9 where they await Lucci's return in the Tower of Justice.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 02
episodes.title: The Big Showdown on the Judiciary Island!!
episodes.description: Luffy launches a one-man assault on Enies Lobby, and the rest of his allies work to break the first gate's defenses. What awaits Galley-La and the Franky Family at the second gate is a showdown of massive proportions!

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 03
episodes.title: Express to the Main Island of Enies Lobby
episodes.description: Robin and Franky are finally brought before Spandam while Luffy continues to blast through waves of marines. Galley-La and the Franky Family still have one giant to deal with, and the main gate closes to halt Rocketman's entry.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 04
episodes.title: Fired
episodes.description: The Straw Hats struggle to catch up to Luffy, who is already on the main island wreaking havoc for the Marines. Meanwhile, Robin learns from Spandam that the terms of their deal have changed, and he somehow has rights to a buster call.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 05
episodes.title: Signal the Counterstrike
episodes.description: Luffy makes it just outside the courthouse when Blueno of CP9 appears before him, and on the main road, the Straw Hats near the courthouse plaza aboard Sodom and Gomorrah. Meanwhile, Sogeking comes across a dejected Oimo.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 06
episodes.title: Unprecedented
episodes.description: Kaku and Kalifa of CP9 are offered a rare chance for new powers and are each served a devil fruit. The Straw Hats finally arrive at the courthouse plaza when Spandam receives an urgent call, and he realizes things are much worse than previously reported.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 07
episodes.title: Gear Second
episodes.description: The Straw Hats storm the courthouse where the three-headed judge Baskerville awaits to enact violent judgment upon them. On the roof, Luffy thanks CP9's Blueno for the strength of his opponents, and he activates a new ability.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 08
episodes.title: The Girl They Called a Devil
episodes.description: Twenty years ago, Nico Robin grew up on Ohara in the West Blue, striving to become an archaeologist like her mother. When Robin met Saul, a giant who washed onto the shores of Ohara, her life would forever be changed.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 09
episodes.title: Ohara vs. The World Government
episodes.description: Robin's mother Olvia was on the run from the World Government, and tragedy was unavoidable from the moment Professor Clover and his colleagues decided to continue their research. No one on Ohara was safe.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 10
episodes.title: Declaration of War
episodes.description: To prove his undying loyalty to Robin, Luffy makes a defiant statement to the World Government.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 11
episodes.title: Jump into the Waterfall!!
episodes.description: Franky stages his own rebellious act against Spandam while Luffy's crew makes a daring leap of faith to hopefully gain entrance to the Tower of Justice.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 12
episodes.title: Pirates vs. CP9
episodes.description: The Straw Hats split up to find the correct key before Robin’s fate is sealed. Zoro finds and engages Kaku in battle, and Sogeking attempts to steal a key from the sleeping Jabra.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 13
episodes.title: Mr. Chivalry
episodes.description: Sanji faces his greatest weakness: fighting a beautiful woman! Meanwhile, Franky begins to run low on cola energy, but he must battle the peculiar Fukuro to obtain more of his refreshing fuel from the kitchen.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 14
episodes.title: Vitality Response
episodes.description: Refreshed and refueled, Franky turns the tide in his battle with Fukuro. Meanwhile, Zoro and Sogeking must find a way to compensate for their self-imposed handicap, and Chopper unfortunately comes face-to-face with Kumadori.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 15
episodes.title: Monster
episodes.description: Chopper's abuse of his rumble balls results in a monstrous side effect. In the meantime, Nami learns how Kalifa's new devil fruit powers sapped Sanji of his strength, and a determined Luffy finally catches up to Spandam, Lucci and Robin.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 16
episodes.title: The Terrifying Emergency Broadcast
episodes.description: As the Marines eke out a comeback against the Straw Hats’ allies, Spandam makes the call Robin most dreaded. In the meantime, Lucci and Luffy begin their mutually anticipated duel, while Nami and Kalifa's fight enters the next phase.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 17
episodes.title: The Hunter
episodes.description: Kalifa attempts to counter Nami’s mirages, and something must be done to save Chopper, still on a monstrous rampage. Zoro, now uncuffed, resumes his duel with Kaku. As Sogeking reaches his limit against Jabra, Sanji reappears, and he is hunting wolves.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 18
episodes.title: Sanji vs. Jabra
episodes.description: As Nami drags the wounded Sogeking from the fight to go find Robin, he suddenly counters with a better idea. In the meantime, Sanji faces off against Jabra's Iron Body Kenpo, and, to break the latter's defenses, Sanji unveils his latest technique.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 19
episodes.title: Zoro vs. Kaku
episodes.description: Spandam drags Robin along the Bridge of Hesitation and finally arrives at the Gates of Justice. Meanwhile, Zoro continues his clash with Kaku, and as things become more desperate, Zoro's rage begins to manifest as a dark aura.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 20
episodes.title: Buster Call
episodes.description: Luffy gives Franky the opening he needs to head for Robin. The cyborg runs into trouble at the start of the bridge, but all is not lost as a lone sniper appears atop the Tower of Justice. Despite these minor victories, the buster call commences.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 21
episodes.title: Rob Lucci
episodes.description: With time running out, Luffy activates another special ability. The vice admirals of the buster call are shocked to see Luffy taking on Rob Lucci and recall how the CP9 enforcer, even in his youth, held strongly to a dark sense of justice.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 22
episodes.title: The Legend of the Mermaid
episodes.description: Lucci corners Luffy, weakened by his new ability’s aftereffects. Back on the bridge, Spandam makes an attempt on Robin's life, so Franky jumps into action. Meanwhile, the rest of the gang is about to drown in the flooded passageway.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 23
episodes.title: We're Not in Hell
episodes.description: The Straw Hats watch as Enies Lobby burns, and Franky fears for his men when he hears of a successful attack against them. Luffy resumes his fight against Lucci while 200 Marine captains bear down on his crewmates.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 24
episodes.title: Utter Defeat
episodes.description: Luffy has finally defeated Rob Lucci, and good news arrives that the Franky Family and Galley-La foremen are all alive and well. As the Straw Hats scramble to escape the Marines, they hear a voice telling them to jump into the sea.

episodes.label: Enies Lobby 25
episodes.title: A Gentle Snowfall of Remembrance
episodes.description: Enies Lobby and the buster call fleet are out of sight, but the Going Merry begins to break apart. The Straw Hats are intercepted by Iceburg aboard his company ship and discover how the Merry found her way back to them one last time.

arcs.title: Post-Enies Lobby
arcs.description: The Straw Hats return to Water Seven after the ordeal at Enies Lobby. While there, they are met by a familial vice admiral, and they await news of their new ship.

episodes.label: Post-Enies Lobby 01
episodes.title: Fist of Love
episodes.description: Two days later in Water Seven, Franky hears that the item he purchased with the Straw Hats' stolen money has arrived. While the pirates recover from the events at Enies Lobby, a Marine vice admiral arrives to pay Luffy an unexpected visit.

episodes.label: Post-Enies Lobby 02
episodes.title: The Extent of the Grand Line and The 600,000,000 Crew!
episodes.description: In the New World, not even the Marines' best can keep Red-Haired Shanks from meeting Whitebeard with an especially important request. Meanwhile, at Water Seven, the Franky Family comes to the Straw Hats with some "bad" news.

episodes.description: The Straw Hats have barely had time to marvel at their new bounties when a new surprise awaits them: the unveiling of their magnificent new ship. The next step is bringing a shipwright into their ranks, and there is only one man for the job.

arcs.title: Thriller Bark
arcs.description: The Straw Hats' next destination is Fishman Island, but first they must traverse the dreaded Florian Triangle which is known for many eerie and mysterious things such as disappearing crews, conversational skeletons, and a floating island full of zombies and other horrors.

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 01
episodes.title: The Mysterious Sea and The Skeleton Brook!
episodes.description: The Thousand Sunny gets flung into the foggy Florian Triangle and the Straw Hats encounter a ruined ship. Speculating as to whether there are ghosts aboard, it turns out the pirates are not far from the truth.

files.path: [One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark [720p]/[One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark Episode 01 [720p][30D0916C].mkv

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 02
episodes.title: Adventure on the Ghost Island and the Famous Doctor Hogback!
episodes.description: Brook bids the Straw Hats farewell, and they decide to explore the nearby ghost island Thriller Bark. Freakish danger awaits the landing party the moment they arrive, and, back on the Sunny, the rest of the crew is harassed by an unseen foe.

files.path: [One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark [720p]/[One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark Episode 02 [720p][EA100F0C].mkv

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 03
episodes.title: The Invisible Man and the Secret of the Mansion!
episodes.description: While staying at Hogback's eerie mansion, Nami is assaulted by an invisible figure in the shower. It does not end there as Usopp battles haunted paintings with a handful of candles. Meanwhile, the rest of the Straw Hats finally make landfall.

files.path: [One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark [720p]/[One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark Episode 03 [720p][C2AAAAF7].mkv

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 04
episodes.title: General Zombie Night! Thriller Bark's Mysterious Four
episodes.description: The Straw Hats learn that the head honcho on the island is one of the Seven Warlords, and he has concocted a shadowy scheme. As Absalom rallies the zombies, the master of Thriller Bark awakens.

files.path: [One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark [720p]/[One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark Episode 04 [720p][EB4DA5F4].mkv

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 05
episodes.title: Perona's Wonder Garden and the Charge of the General Zombies!
episodes.description: Nami, Usopp, and Chopper manage to escape their coffin but find themselves in a garden surrounded by animal zombies, including one acting remarkably like Sanji. It also seems that one by one, the Straw Hats are disappearing.

files.path: [One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark [720p]/[One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark Episode 05 [720p][5B4DF29D].mkv

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 06
episodes.title: Number 900?! Lola's Pursuit and the Humming Swordsman
episodes.description: Lola attacks Nami out of ignorant jealousy, but the Sanji-esque zombie plays interference. Meanwhile, with Luffy captured, and Franky and Robin left to face a massive spider monkey, a familiar bony figure falls from the sky.

files.path: [One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark [720p]/[One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark Episode 06 [720p][60E33665].mkv

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 07
episodes.title: The Fearsome Ability of the Shadow Fruit! The Ultimate Number 900!
episodes.description: Gecko Moria takes his next step toward his goal of eventually becoming king of the pirates by creating the ultimate zombie. Luffy's shadow in hand, Moria begins the revival of the much-anticipated number 900.

files.path: [One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark [720p]/[One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark Episode 07 [720p][1E847368].mkv

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 08
episodes.title: Oars' Awakening and Brook vs. Ryuma!
episodes.description: Dead for 500 years and left in a deep freeze since, Oars awakens, fueled by Luffy's shadow. Soon after, Nami, Usopp, and Chopper are discovered hiding inside Perona's pet bear, and Absalom abducts Nami for his demented marriage ceremony.

files.path: [One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark [720p]/[One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark Episode 08 [720p][694AD702].mkv

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 09
episodes.title: The Hope and Despair of the Skeleton and the Straw Hats' Counterattack!
episodes.description: The Straw Hats regroup on the Sunny in a pitiable state, but not before Brook leaves Franky with some valuable information. In addition, they now know of the promise Brook made to a certain friend fifty years ago, someone the Straw Hats know well.

files.path: [One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark [720p]/[One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark Episode 09 [720p][19D3B6A3].mkv

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 10
episodes.title: Already Negative! Usopp's Courageous Stand!
episodes.description: Oars' entry into the fight suddenly changes everything! Then, when Perona attacks, only one of the pirates seems to be immune to her negative powers. Due to his glass-half-empty personality, Usopp might have what it takes to defeat the Ghost Princess.

files.path: [One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark [720p]/[One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark Episode 10 [720p] [38BBF05C].mkv

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 11
episodes.title: A Stolen Dream! Sanji vs. Absalom
episodes.description: Sanji crashes Absalom's sham of a wedding, the fire in his heart burning brightly as he rescues Nami. A curious connection between Sanji and the Clear-Clear Fruit is revealed, and he vows to defeat Absalom for ruining his lifelong dream.

files.path: [One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark [720p]/[One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark Episode 11 [720p][D538CFD7].mkv

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 12
episodes.title: Perona's Terror! Usopp vs. the Ghost Princess!
episodes.description: After getting the stuffing beat out of him by a zombie teddy bear, Usopp summons his sharp-shooting alter ego to help him discover the secret to defeating Perona! He reaches deep into his devious bag of tricks to even the odds in this spooky battle.

files.path: [One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark [720p]/[One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark Episode 12 [720p][8B836836].mkv

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 13
episodes.title: Zoro vs. Ryuuma and Chopper's Rage!
episodes.description: Zoro stands in for Brook and duels Ryuma, the swordsman zombie from faraway Wano. In the mansion, Chopper's former respect for Dr. Hogback is completely erased after coming to realize the man's twisted views on life.

files.path: [One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark [720p]/[One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark Episode 13 [720p][3AEE90B8].mkv

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 14
episodes.title: Show Yourselves, Straw Hat Pirates! The Crew's Hopeless Counterattack!
episodes.description: With Oars now a fully obedient zombie, Gecko Moria takes his leave while instructing the giant to hunt down the pirates, whose wanted posters are sewn onto his arm. One by one, the Straw Hats' battles are interrupted by Oars' march around Thriller Bark.

files.path: [One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark [720p]/[One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark Episode 14 [720p][7CAE5640].mkv

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 15
episodes.title: Clash! The Titanic Battle Against Zombie 900!
episodes.description: The Straw Hats sans Luffy are faced with the insurmountable task of taking out Oars. To knock him down, Franky decides they will need to use his newly developed tactic. But as they begin "docking" onto one another, a slight problem arises.

files.path: [One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark [720p]/[One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark Episode 15 [720p][A9784E2B].mkv

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 16
episodes.title: The Mysterious Visitor! The Two Warlords Meet!
episodes.description: While the Straw Hats continue to wear away at Oars, Nami confronts Perona attempting to escape on board the Thousand Sunny, but the sudden appearance of a large, mysterious figure soon makes her efforts moot.

files.path: [One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark [720p]/[One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark Episode 16 [720p][EF1D7B5F].mkv

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 17
episodes.title: Combination of Brains and Brawn! Oars and Moriah vs. the Straw Hats!
episodes.description: To give Luffy a fighting chance against Moria, Lola and her pirate crew propose a plan to fight shadow with shadow. Meanwhile, Gecko Moria uses his abilities to enhance and manipulate Oars’ massive body.

files.path: [One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark [720p]/[One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark Episode 17 [720p][6AAC9B33].mkv

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 18
episodes.title: The Crew's Annihilation! Oars vs. Nightmare Luffy
episodes.description: Moria’s strange combination with Oars defeats the Straw Hats one after the other. They are at their breaking point when a powerful figure swoops in and takes up the fight in their stead. The hellish creation: Nightmare Luffy!

files.path: [One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark [720p]/[One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark Episode 18 [720p][2295F0A1].mkv

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 19
episodes.title: Morning Comes! The Straw Hats' Ultimate Attack!
episodes.description: Oars recovers from Nightmare Luffy's assault, but the Straw Hats all get back on their feet and launch a final devastating attack on Oars. Morning fast approaches, and Moria is far from finished, ready to use his ultimate technique.

files.path: [One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark [720p]/[One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark Episode 19 [720p][099FB95D].mkv

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 20
episodes.title: The Power That Can Deflect Anything?! Zoro Fights Prepared to Die!
episodes.description: Moria’s defeat returns the shadows of all his victims. However, one Warlord remains on the island, and he has orders to terminate the Straw Hats and everyone else in the area. A lone Zoro faces Kuma in vain and is presented with a deadly choice.

files.path: [One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark [720p]/[One Pace] Paced One Piece - Thriller Bark Episode 20 [720p][AD2D4BCD].mkv

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 21
episodes.title: Brook's Past! The Rumbar Pirates and Laboon!
episodes.description: Brook recalls his past, thinking back on the time when the small whale Laboon started following his pirate ship and befriended the crew.

episodes.label: Thriller Bark 22
episodes.title: Brook's Promise! The Eighth Member
episodes.description: At death's door, the Rumbar Pirates sang "Binks' Brew" one last time and recorded it in a tone dial, hoping to one day deliver it to Laboon. With their new crewmate and musician Brook on board, the Straw Hats bid farewell to Lola’s crew.

arcs.description: The second half of the Grand Line lays just ahead, so the Straw Hats stop at Sabaody Archipelago to plan the way forward. But being so close to the Holy Land and Navy Headquarters, Luffy's crew comes face-to-face with the darkest forces of the World Government.

episodes.label: Sabaody Archipelago 01
episodes.title: Flying Fish Riders
episodes.description: As the Straw Hats journey to Fishman Island, they reach the Red Line, the halfway point along the Grand Line. When a sea king appears, Luffy easily dispatches it, but it spits up a mermaid and a talking starfish onto the deck of the Sunny.

episodes.description: Nami's group arrives at the Grove 1 auction house where Camie will be sold to the highest bidder. With 200 million berries in hand, Nami is determined to win back their friend. The auction wears on as Luffy and co. race to the grove.

episodes.title: Kizaru vs. the Four Captains

arcs.title: Amazon Lily
arcs.description: Luffy is separated from his crew, and he finds himself on an unfamiliar island in the middle of the Calm Belt... an island inhabited only by women where men are prohibited from entering.

episodes.label: Amazon Lily 01
episodes.title: Adventure on the Island of Women
episodes.description: Luffy finds himself alone, stranded and starving on an unfamiliar island. After a run-in with some exotic mushrooms, he is approached by a team of female warriors who could be friend... or foe.

episodes.title: Pirate Empress Boa Hancock
episodes.description: Luffy storms the village of women in hopes of acquiring a boat. However, a misstep lands him in the personal bath of none other than the Snake Princess. As he peers through the steam rising from its waters, he sees a forbidden secret etched upon her back.

episodes.label: Amazon Lily 03
episodes.title: The Arena
episodes.description: Luffy is sentenced to execution by arena combat with Boa Hancock’s serpentine sisters. Luffy soon discovers that the two women have a mysterious ability that allows them to slither through all his attacks unharmed.

episodes.label: Amazon Lily 04
episodes.title: Hancock's Confession
episodes.description: Impressed by Luffy’s efforts to protect the secret of the snake sisters, Hancock reveals the story behind the familiar mark on their backs. Their childhood was tragic, suffered at the hands of a corrupt group that Luffy knows all too well.

episodes.label: Amazon Lily 05
episodes.title: No One Can Stop This Now
episodes.description: As Luffy prepares to depart Amazon Lily, Hancock suddenly takes ill. Taking heed of the knowledge and wisdom of Elder Nyon, the Snake Princess “recovers,” and a plan to save Ace is quickly hatched.

arcs.title: Impel Down
arcs.description: Luffy launches a daring rescue mission to break his big brother Ace from the government prison, Impel Down. It's a race to the prison's lowest levels — a literal journey through hell itself.

episodes.label: Impel Down 01
episodes.title: The Underwater Prison, Impel Down
episodes.description: To rescue his brother Ace, Luffy must infiltrate the well-guarded prison Impel Down. He eludes the watchful eyes of security for a time, and then, for better or worse, a certain red-nosed criminal appears.

episodes.label: Impel Down 02
episodes.title: First Son of the Sea
episodes.description: After forming an unlikely alliance, Luffy rushes through Impel Down aided by Buggy's powers. Meanwhile, Ace finds himself with an unlikely companion as well when he exchanges words with a powerful pirate prisoner.

files.path: [One Pace][525-548] Impel Down [720p]/[One Pace][527-528] Impel Down 02 [720p][7306EDA1].mkv

episodes.label: Impel Down 03
episodes.title: From One Hell to Another
episodes.description: Luffy and his dubious companions face off against the mythical beasts of Level 2. Impel Down is put on lockdown, its only exit sealed, but Luffy, unaware and unafraid, continues to Ace's floor, only to have another unexpected reunion.

episodes.label: Impel Down 04
episodes.title: Inferno Hell
episodes.description: Luffy and his deranged team pummel everything from Level 3 to Level 4 that dares to stand in their path. However, the powerful guard Minotaurus is ready to do some pummeling of his own while a boiling bath of blood awaits below.

episodes.label: Impel Down 05
episodes.title: Friend
episodes.description: With nowhere to run, Luffy's desperation to save Ace forces him to make a very grim sacrifice against his venomous adversary. Down in the frozen depths of Level 5, Bon Kurei rushes to his friend's aid, betting on a distant hope.

episodes.title: A Ray of Hope
