arcs.title: Marineford
arcs.description: Pirate Whitebeard and his allies on one side; the Navy and its Seven Warlords on the other. At the center of it all: Portgas D. Ace and his unspeakable past and heritage. Luffy races to Ace's execution scaffold as a battle between the world's most powerful people unfolds.

episodes.label: Marineford 01
episodes.title: Marine Headquarters
episodes.description: Fifty warships, 100,000 Marines, the Seven Warlords, and three admirals: Akainu, Aokiji, and Kizaru. The stage is set, and, as a battle with Whitebeard looms, Fleet Admiral Sengoku reveals a shocking truth about Ace.

episodes.label: Marineford 02
episodes.title: Ace and Whitebeard
episodes.description: To the surprise of all, the Moby Dick surfaces in the middle of Marineford! On the deck stands Whitebeard, the man who Ace calls father, and his fourteen commanders, the pirates he calls family, who share Luffy’s determination to stop the execution.

episodes.label: Marineford 03
episodes.title: Conflict at the Summit
episodes.description: The players have assembled at last! Whitebeard unleashes a tsunami that is set to swallow every marine and turn Marine HQ upside down. The fight has just begun, as Marine admirals and pirate commanders alike showcase their incredible abilities.

episodes.label: Marineford 04
episodes.title: Justice Will Prevail!!
episodes.description: A larger-than-life ally risks his life to pave the way forward, and the Whitebeard Pirates rush toward Ace. However, just as their rescue mission picks up momentum, Sengoku employs a surprise tactic that turns the tide yet again.

episodes.label: Marineford 05
episodes.title: Luffy and Whitebeard
episodes.description: Luffy leaps into the fray! Battling against familiar faces and new foes alike, he races toward the scaffold like a whirlwind of destruction, and, as his brother begs for him to turn back, Luffy shares some powerful words of his own.

episodes.label: Marineford 06
episodes.title: The Prisoners of Impel Down
episodes.description: Facing Kuma on the battlefield, Ivankov reveals their shared past, but his pleas to his old companion fall on deaf ears as Kuma continues his attacks. In a sea of confusion, only Doflamingo seems to know the truth.

episodes.label: Marineford 07
episodes.title: The Whirl Spider
episodes.description: Luffy’s progress is halted by Mihawk, but the Whitebeard Pirates counter with a swordsman of their own. Then, when an army of human weapons encircle the battlefield, Luffy and his allies find themselves overwhelmed by their explosive attacks.

episodes.label: Marineford 08
episodes.title: The Man Who Shook the World
episodes.description: Squard’s betrayal of Whitebeard sends ripples of distrust and uncertainty throughout the pirate alliance. And yet, Whitebeard’s faith will not be shattered, and it soon becomes clear that his allies are falling into a clever setup launched by the Marines.

episodes.label: Marineford 09
episodes.title: Assault
episodes.description: The pirates are trapped in the bay, held there by Akainu’s magma. Amid the chaos, the order for Ace’s execution is given, and Luffy makes a drastic decision that puts him face-to-face with the Marines' most powerful men.

episodes.label: Marineford 10
episodes.title: Oris Plaza
episodes.description: His adopted son within reach, Whitebeard charges forth, undeterred by the strongest the Marines have to offer. With both sides swinging between victory and defeat, the battlefield plunges into chaos. Then Marco takes to the sky and soars to Ace’s side!

episodes.label: Marineford 11
episodes.title: The White Monster
episodes.description: Faced with the might of the admirals, even Whitebeard's commanders falter. Refusing to relent, Luffy begs Ivankov for a final chance at victory. Amid a bevy of Marines, an old friend of Luffy’s appears for a much too premature reunion.

episodes.label: Marineford 12
episodes.title: The Execution Platform
episodes.description: Having borne witness to Luffy’s latent powers, the Marines send everything they have at him. But thanks to Ivankov’s quick thinking, Luffy ascends toward Ace. Garp, unable to watch any longer, leaps into Luffy’s path.

episodes.label: Marineford 13
episodes.title: The Times They Are A-Changin'
episodes.description: Ace is free at last, and the pair of brothers are unstoppable! Although the Whitebeard Pirates are emboldened by their teamwork, their captain is not convinced that their escape will come so easily, and Whitebeard makes a difficult decision.

episodes.label: Marineford 14
episodes.title: Thank You for Loving Me
episodes.description: Ace protects his brother from Akainu but suffers a mortal blow in the process. Jinbe and the Whitebeard Pirates rush to his aid but soon realize he is far beyond help. As Ace takes his final breaths, he imparts a heartfelt message.

episodes.label: Marineford 15
episodes.title: Edward Newgate
episodes.description: Blackbeard appears, Thatch’s murder and Ace’s capture all part of a terrifying plan that no one could have imagined! With the war in its final stage, Whitebeard fights to avenge his fallen sons and to punish the traitor who plotted his undoing.

episodes.label: Marineford 16
episodes.title: A Gift to a New Era
episodes.description: Though Ace and Whitebeard have been killed, the Marines seek to wipe out every last pirate, even as they retreat. In the confusion, Akainu sets his eyes on the unconscious Luffy. Meanwhile, Blackbeard reveals his true scheme and a terrifying new power!

episodes.label: Marineford 17
episodes.title: The War's Conclusion
episodes.description: Senseless violence dyes the battlefield red with blood. Luffy’s allies struggle to save him as the admirals maintain their assault. Suddenly, the Red Hair Pirates appear! Narrowly missing a reunion with Luffy, Shanks utters a speech on the battlefield.

arcs.title: Post-War
arcs.description: The war has taken its toll on the world, and Luffy reminisces about younger days when he first met Ace and became his brother. To become strong enough to withstand the New World, Luffy must make a critical decision for himself and his crew.

episodes.label: Post-War 01
episodes.title: Creeping Future
episodes.description: The Summit War has thrown the entire world into chaos. Emboldened by Whitebeard's final words, pirates once again envision a wave they can ride into a new era. At Hancock’s order, Luffy is taken to Amazon Lily to hide from the Marines while he recovers.

episodes.label: Post-War 02
episodes.title: Gray Terminal
episodes.description: Before they were brothers, Ace and Luffy lived in the mountains, dreaming of the day when they would take to the sea. In the criminal-infested junkyard known as Gray Terminal, Ace and his partner-in-crime Sabo robbed the thieves and scavengers.

episodes.label: Post-War 03
episodes.title: Oath of Brotherhood
episodes.description: Ace, Sabo, and Luffy made a promise to one another over cups of sake that would shape their futures. Yet while the brothers' adventures continue, Sabo's unfortunate past catches up with him. Meanwhile, a horrific plot unfolds.

episodes.label: Post-War 04
episodes.title: Sabo's Sea
episodes.description: Even as the fires in Gray Terminal threatened to consume them, Ace and Luffy fought Bluejam with all their might! In the wake of the tragedy, Sabo seized freedom in his hands and took to the sea, just as a Celestial Dragon arrived in High Town.

episodes.label: Post-War 05
episodes.title: Will of the Winds
episodes.description: Luffy and Ace buried their sorrow and grew stronger day by day as they trained to be pirates. Time marched on, and they eventually bade farewell to their childhood home and took to the sea, hoping to achieve the dream that Sabo could not.

episodes.label: Post-War 06
episodes.title: Cheer
episodes.description: Determined to return to Sabaody and keep his promise to his crew, Luffy prepares for departure. However, when Dark King Rayleigh appears and makes him a surprising offer, Luffy is forced to make a decision that could alter the fate of his entire journey.

episodes.label: Post-War 07
episodes.title: NEWS
episodes.description: Although Marine HQ is in ruins after the Summit War, Marines and reporters still stalk its grounds. Luffy, Rayleigh, and Jinbe return to where Ace died to carry out a mysterious plan. If all goes well, Luffy’s crew will understand his actions.

episodes.label: Post-War 08
episodes.title: 3D2Y
episodes.description: The Straw Hat Pirates have interpreted their captain's message to meet up again in two years. During this time, they will prepare themselves for the New World! In the Calm Belt, Luffy arrives in Luscaina to begin training under Rayleigh.

arcs.title: Return to Sabaody
arcs.description: Two years have passed since the Straw Hats were forcibly separated, and they reconvene back at Sabaody stronger and even more committed to the journey ahead.

episodes.label: Return to Sabaody 01
episodes.title: Two Years Later
episodes.description: Two years after the Summit War, the Straw Hat crew finally returns to Sabaody. However, the archipelago has changed, and with dangerous pirates lurking around in droves, their departure to the New World may not go as smoothly as hoped.

episodes.label: Return to Sabaody 02
episodes.title: Island of New Beginnings
episodes.description: Luffy, in disguise, crosses paths with the fake Luffy, and the imposter finds himself on the receiving end of a mysterious power. Meanwhile, Sentomaru and the Marines have yet again amassed a team of Pacifistas.

episodes.title: Dive, Dive, Dive!
episodes.description: After two long years and one chaotic afternoon, the Straw Hats are finally ready to renew their voyage. However, before they can set off to Fishman Island, they must contend with a massive Marine force determined to stop them.

arcs.title: Fishman Island
arcs.description: The path the to the New World takes the Straw Hats thousands of leagues under the sea to the underwater Fishman Island. However, the island's dark past is reaching a breaking point, and Luffy and his crew are caught in the middle of the conflict.

episodes.label: Fishman Island 01
episodes.title: To the Deep Sea
episodes.description: Encased in a protective bubble, the Sunny departs for Fishman Island far under the sea. As the Straw Hats marvel at the sights, Franky tells the crew about their greatest ally in their time apart. But suddenly, a mysterious shadow closes in on the ship.

episodes.label: Fishman Island 02
episodes.title: Adventure in the Ocean Depths! 10 Kilometers Below the Surface!
episodes.description: Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji leave the relative safety of the Sunny to face the Kraken in its own territory. Putting their powerful new skills to work, they survive the encounter but are swept away by a downward current and become lost in the murky depths.

episodes.label: Fishman Island 03
episodes.title: Landing on Fishman Island! The Mermaid Cove and Gyoverly Hills!
episodes.description: After a near miss with a creepy undersea ship and Fishman Island in sight, Luffy’s crew is halted by a group of fishmen riding atop sea kings. But time is of the essence, so the Straw Hats attempt a desperate maneuver.

files.path: [One Pace][603-653] Fishman Island [720p]/[One Pace][607-608] Fishman Island 03 [720p][5636E014].mkv

episodes.label: Fishman Island 04
episodes.title: Arrival at Coral Hill! The Nosebleed and the Devastating Prediction!
episodes.description: The mermaids of Fishman Island give the Straw Hats a warm welcome, but Sanji is struck with a sudden medical emergency! Luffy and co. take their anemic friend to the Mermaid Cafe to rest, where they are introduced to its soothsaying owner.

episodes.label: Fishman Island 05
episodes.title: The King of Fishman Island Invited to Ryugu Palace!
episodes.description: The pirates receive an unexpected invitation to Ryugu Palace from Neptune himself, king of Fishman Island. Tempted by the smell of food, Luffy wanders the palace and soon finds an enormous tower with a sturdy yet battle-worn door.

episodes.label: Fishman Island 06
episodes.title: The Mermaid Princess in Hard-Shell Tower! Shirahoshi of the Neptune Family!
episodes.description: Plagued by the unwanted advances of a lunatic fishman with a dangerous power, Mermaid Princess Shirahoshi has been hidden away in a lonely tower for years. Meanwhile in the palace, things take a sour turn for the Straw Hats.

episodes.label: Fishman Island 07
episodes.title: The Shirahoshi Kidnapping Incident and the Curse of the Mato Mato!
episodes.description: Ryugu Palace falls into chaos. While Luffy escapes with Shirahoshi, the pirates who infiltrated its walls attack with a strange desperation. After a scuffle of their own, Sanji and Chopper come across an old friend with troubling injuries.

files.path: [One Pace][603-653] Fishman Island [720p]/[One Pace][614-615] Fishman Island 07 [720p][29A10280].mkv

episodes.label: Fishman Island 08
episodes.title: The Beginning of the Vengeful Plan! Zoro vs. Hody!
episodes.description: Hody’s plan for revenge is set in motion, and the Straw Hats who have unwittingly taken control of the palace must now defend it against the New Fishman Pirates. Outside, Luffy’s excursion with Shirahoshi is rudely interrupted.

episodes.label: Fishman Island 09
episodes.title: At the Sea Forest! Arlong and Hody
episodes.description: Jinbe reunites with Luffy in the undersea forest and reveals a shocking connection to an old foe. The former Warlord begins a tale of when two famous figures fought to undo the animosity that existed between humans and fishmen.

episodes.label: Fishman Island 10
episodes.title: Otohime, Fisher Tiger, and the Sun Pirates! The Fateful Encounter!
episodes.description: Queen Otohime tried to lead the Ryugu Kingdom into an era of coexistence between humans and fishmen. At the same time, the heroic Fisher Tiger battled humans to free their slaves from captivity.

files.path: [One Pace][603-653] Fishman Island [720p]/[One Pace][621-622] Fishman Island 10 [720p][F4BB17EB].mkv

episodes.label: Fishman Island 11
episodes.title: The Shocking Truth of Tiger! The End of the Sun Pirates
episodes.description: Fisher Tiger’s past quickly caught up to him, and he left his crew with a sobering, final command. While Jinbe vowed to uphold Tiger’s and Otohime’s ideals, Arlong’s resentment only grew, and soon, the Sun Pirates faced a crisis of identity.

episodes.label: Fishman Island 12
episodes.title: The Shipwrecked Celestial Dragon! A Bullet That Seals the Future
episodes.description: The sudden appearance of a Celestial Dragon almost imperiled Fishman Island, but Queen Otohime’s ability to end hostilities provided a ray of hope for everyone. Just when the path to the future seemed bright, a shot echoed through the plaza.

files.path: [One Pace][603-653] Fishman Island [720p]/[One Pace][625-626] Fishman Island 12 [720p][F134C10A].mkv

episodes.label: Fishman Island 13
episodes.title: Shaking of the Kingdom! Luffy vs. Jinbe!
episodes.description: After completing his tale, Jinbe begs Nami for forgiveness. Soon after, Hody broadcasts across all of Fishman Island, and all watch in horror as he conducts his hostile takeover. Luffy is ready to fight, but Jinbe has something else in mind.

files.path: [One Pace][603-653] Fishman Island [720p]/[One Pace][627-629] Fishman Island 13 [720p][04C7B716].mkv

episodes.label: Fishman Island 14
episodes.title: Gyoncorde Plaza Gathering! The Evil Drug's True Power
episodes.description: Hody experiences a strange side effect of the energy steroids, and his body undergoes a horrifying transformation! The three princes of the Ryugu Kingdom rush to the scene, but Hody's crewmates have a dirty trick up their sleeves.

files.path: [One Pace][603-653] Fishman Island [720p]/[One Pace][630-631] Fishman Island 14 [720p][35A189E2].mkv

episodes.label: Fishman Island 15
episodes.title: Hody's Dark Secret! The Straw Hats' Arrival
episodes.description: Shirahoshi and Jinbe hurry to free King Neptune but run headlong into a trap. There, Hody reveals a shocking truth about the history of his revolution, but even in the face of Hody’s cruelty, Shirahoshi holds true to her mother’s dying wish.

files.path: [One Pace][603-653] Fishman Island [720p]/[One Pace][632-633] Fishman Island 15 [720p][8014A332].mkv

episodes.label: Fishman Island 16
episodes.title: 100,000 vs. 10! The Straw Hats' Explosive Moves
episodes.description: The Straw Hats have reassembled at last, an army of New Fishman Pirates standing before them. With the last two years still fresh in their minds, the Straw Hats’ training is put to the test, and they unleash a flurry of new techniques.

episodes.label: Fishman Island 17
episodes.title: The General from the Future Land and the Crisis of Fishman Island's Destruction
episodes.description: Franky’s mechanical masterpieces have transformations in store that can only be described as "super!" However, onlookers curb their enthusiasm when a foreboding shadow is cast upon the plaza by a giant ship hurtling toward the island!

episodes.label: Fishman Island 18
episodes.title: I'll Protect Everything
episodes.description: Shirahoshi flees into the open sea, hoping to draw the Noah away from Fishman Island. Luffy follows her, but he must contend with Hody Jones along the way. Luckily, the appearance of a new ally gives Luffy a chance to protect Shirahoshi.

episodes.label: Fishman Island 19
episodes.title: What Are You?
episodes.description: The Straw Hats hold their own against the powerful officers from Hody’s crew. But their struggle will be in vain if Luffy cannot stop the Noah. Meanwhile, Hody becomes stronger than ever.

episodes.label: Fishman Island 20
episodes.title: Phantom
episodes.description: Neptune’s army aids the Straw Hats against the New Fishman Pirates, finally accepting the crew as allies. As the fight continues, Fukaboshi’s transponder snail reveals the bone chilling truth behind Hody's motivations.

files.path: [One Pace][603-653] Fishman Island [720p]/[One Pace][642-645] Fishman Island 20 [720p][94E2099D].mkv

episodes.label: Fishman Island 21
episodes.title: Death Is Also Revenge
episodes.description: Luffy has a fist of fire with Hody’s name on it, and the rest of the Straw Hats push forward with all their might. Hody takes even more energy steroids, and a gravely injured Luffy struggles to overcome the fishman's unbelievable stamina.

files.path: [One Pace][603-653] Fishman Island [720p]/[One Pace][643-646] Fishman Island 21 [720p][85AD9C81].mkv

episodes.label: Fishman Island 22
episodes.title: The Path Toward the Sun
episodes.description: Hody is vanquished, the Noah is stopped, and Fishman Island is saved! Unfortunately, Luffy was gravely injured in the process. With no time to spare, a true friend steps forward to tear down the walls of the island's history.

files.path: [One Pace][603-653] Fishman Island [720p]/[One Pace][647-649] Fishman Island 22 [720p][7DBBFA18].mkv

episodes.label: Fishman Island 23
episodes.title: The Voice from the New World
episodes.description: When pirates working for Big Mom appear, Fishman Island falls under threat from an adversary even stronger than Hody. Luffy steps up to save the fishmen once again but may doom himself by antagonizing one of the strongest pirates in the New World.

files.path: [One Pace][603-653] Fishman Island [720p]/[One Pace][650-651] Fishman Island 23 [720p][65BD682D].mkv

episodes.label: Fishman Island 24
episodes.title: The Hero's Hat
episodes.description: Filled with both excitement and trepidation, the crew finally sets sail for the New World. After bidding their fond farewells, the Straw Hats leave with a new log pose in hand. Overcoming trials and tragedies, Luffy's dream is on course once again!

arcs.title: Punk Hazard
arcs.description: The first island of the New World is a strange place covered in flames on one half, and freezing temperatures on the other. What seems at first to be an unlivable place later reveals a laboratory, a maniac scientist, and a certain Warlord of the Sea.

episodes.label: Punk Hazard 01
episodes.title: Punk Hazard
episodes.description: Fresh off the adventure at Fishman Island, the Sunny is caught in a massive whirlpool and dragged off course. A desperate cry for help leads the Straw Hats to Punk Hazard, an island engulfed in flames and inhabited by a mythic beast.

episodes.description: Luffy, Robin, Usopp, and Zoro face a powerful dragon, and Luffy gets up close and personal with a torso-less figure. Elsewhere, Nami, Sanji, Chopper, and Franky find themselves imprisoned with the pieces of a human face!

episodes.title: CC
