arcs.title: Dressrosa
arcs.description: Luffy's alliance with Law brings him next to Dressrosa to take down Doflamingo's booming business. But the crazed warlord and self-proclaimed ruler of Dressrosa has control over everyone and everything.

episodes.label: Dressrosa 01
episodes.title: Arriving at Dressrosa! The Country of Passion, Love, and Toys!
episodes.description: Dressrosa! The Straw Hats split up and set about their business on this passionate, enchanting island! But here, in the heart of enemy territory, danger lurks around every corner. Luffy’s group encounters an intriguing blind man whose luck has run dry.

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 01 [1280x720 x264 AAC][2A35B710].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 02
episodes.title: Corrida Colosseum! The Great Tournament
episodes.description: Zoro and co. strike off in search of the thieving fairy who has taken Zoro's sword, but Sanji gets distracted by the alluring dancing of a gorgeous Dressrosan. Meanwhile, the prize of the late Ace’s devil fruit draws Luffy and Franky to the colosseum.

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 02 [1280x720 x264 AAC][E058DEF9].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 03
episodes.title: The Colosseum of Many New Faces and Maynard the Pursuer!
episodes.description: Luffy enters the tournament at Corrida Colosseum to compete for Ace's fruit, but with the mightiest warriors of the New World assembled and standing in his way, the competition will not be easy. The first stage of the competition is a battle royal!

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 03 [1280x720 x264 AAC][90034ECC].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 04
episodes.title: Bellamy's Changed Motivations and B Block's Start!
episodes.description: When Block A concludes, the crowds are shocked to discover the secret identity of the winner. Block B commences, and the widely despised Bartolomeo takes the ring, but he will have to contend with Dressrosa's own local favorite, Bellamy!

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 04 [1280x720 x264 AAC][E98FA912].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 05
episodes.title: B Block on Fire! Outlandish Competitors and King Punch!
episodes.description: The battle in Block B hits a crescendo as the Fighting King Elizabello II prepares his devastating King Punch! But as the powerful attack becomes imminent, the Kingdom of Prodence faction unravels!

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 05 [1280x720 x264 AAC][A95DE47B].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 06
episodes.title: To Green Bit! The Adventure in the Land of Dwarves!
episodes.description: The Caesar Transfer Team is on approach to Green Bit, but the colossal coastal fish of Dressrosa are biting, and the connecting bridge has collapsed! The team gathers their wits to make it across, but they soon discover they are not alone on the island.

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 06 [1280x720 x264 AAC][F7CB97CD].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 07
episodes.title: Doflamingo Arrives! The Ultimate Schemer!
episodes.description: All but done for, Sanji is trapped by Violet and her crew when she suddenly changes her mind and mysteriously turns on her own men! Sanji gets in touch with Law to share a shocking secret that could unsettle all their plans in Dressrosa.

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 07 [1280x720 x264 AAC][EACE397D].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 08
episodes.title: Closely Contested Block C! Lucy and Ucy!
episodes.description: The Sunny is mysteriously deformed by Giolla’s strange powers! Meanwhile, the battle for Block C is under way, but Luffy suffers a staggering setback. He eventually knocks down the giant Hajrudin, but Chinjao has his sights set on Garp’s grandson!

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 08 [1280x720 x264 AAC][777DE97C].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 09
episodes.title: C Block's Blazing Battle and the Forgotten of Dressrosa!
episodes.description: In the colosseum, Chinjao finally faces Luffy and reveals the old grudge he bears against Garp! Meanwhile, Usopp and Robin get swept up in the Tontattas' raid against the royal family, and Franky learns the eerie secret of Dressrosa’s living toys.

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 09 [1280x720 x264 AAC][C2C37921].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 10
episodes.title: The Tontatta Rebellion and the C Block Finale!
episodes.description: The Tontattas gear up for their all-out assault on the Doflamingo Family, and Usopp and Robin are caught up in the war effort! Meanwhile, Luffy concludes his earth-shattering fight to the death with Don Chinjao.

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 10 [1280x720 x264 AAC][50143351].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 11
episodes.title: A Sad Past! Rebecca and Soldier-san
episodes.description: A voice from the past unsettles Luffy and sends him into a rage! Also, it's discovered that Rebecca's eternal bond with the one-legged toy soldier is linked to the violent overthrow of the old regime, perpetrated by none other than Doflamingo!

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 11 [1280x720 x264 AAC][D8E8370A].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 12
episodes.title: D Block's Fiery Start and the Heavenly Demon's Revelation!
episodes.description: As Rebecca enters the ring for the battle for Block D, the crowd shows its contempt for her heritage and vicious contenders set their sights on her. Meanwhile, Law is pinned by Fujitora, and Doflamingo has the upper hand.

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 12 [1280x720 x264 AAC][F20B5423].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 13
episodes.title: Law's New Strategy and the Colosseum's Underground Nightmare!
episodes.description: Law must put himself in harm's way to defend the Sunny and the Straw Hats from Doflamingo's all-out assault. Meanwhile, Bartolomeo searches the colosseum for Luffy and discovers something strange about the medical center for the defeated.

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 13 [1280x720 x264 AAC][C29E5C35].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 14
episodes.title: The Plight of the Riku Clan! The Lurking Hero Awaits in the Shadows!
episodes.description: The losers of the colosseum who are being held below the infirmary have an unexpected addition to their numbers. Meanwhile, the history of Tontatta is made clear, as is the shocking identity of the toy soldier!

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 14 [1280x720 x264 AAC][E3C90B8B].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 15
episodes.title: Doflamingo's Relentless Pursuit
episodes.description: Revealed is the sad fate of King Riku, his army, and his daughter, Princess Viola, as well as how the people of Dressrosa fell into the hands of Doflamingo. Not to mention, all the toys in the country share a mysterious secret.

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 15 [1280x720 x264 AAC][6A3CE0EA].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 16
episodes.title: SOP Strategy
episodes.description: Zoro and Kin'emon make a mad dash to save Law, but Admiral Fujitora stands in their way, bringing his full power against them. The toy soldier lays out the plan to liberate the Tontattas and bring down the Doflamingo Family: Operation SOP.

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 16 [1280x720 x264 AAC][7073A62F].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 17
episodes.title: The Underground World
episodes.description: Usopp and Robin travel via an underground tunnel dug by the tiny people of the Tontatta Tribe. On the surface, Franky makes his way to the Toys House to cause a distraction to help his crewmates, but standing in his way is quite the guy!

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 17 [1280x720 x264 AAC][174F92DD].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 18
episodes.title: Fujitora's Outlook
episodes.description: Viola, once a princess of the Dressrosan royal family, shows Luffy and the others a secret entrance into the palace. In the meantime, Admiral Fujitora reveals his audacious plans for the Seven Warlords of the Sea!

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 18 [1280x720 x264 AAC][C9362978].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 19
episodes.title: Diamante and Pica
episodes.description: The final round at Corrida Colosseum kicks off, and Diamante joins the combatants in an all-out struggle to win the prize! Meanwhile, Luffy and co., en route to Doflamingo, are faced with an immovable member of the Donquixote Family.

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 19 [1280x720 x264 AAC][77081AEE].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 20
episodes.title: Captain
episodes.description: With Operation SOP in its final stage, the Tontattas are devastated by Trebol’s furious attack, but as Usopp tries to convince Leo to abort the operation, Leo tells him about their commander’s stunning true identity.

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 20 [1280x720 x265 AAC][BE72EB0E].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 21
episodes.title: Usoland the Liar
episodes.description: With the Tontattas beaten, Robin turned into a toy, and Luffy, Franky, and the others busy elsewhere, Usopp is the last hope for Operation SOP! Among the cries of the Tontattas, Usopp has a difficult decision to make.

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 21 [1280x720 x265 AAC][C21EC74A].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 22
episodes.title: Dressrosa in Turmoil
episodes.description: Usopp creates a miracle! Toys across Dressrosa regain their true forms, a flood of lost memories return, and a forgotten hero launches a long overdue attack on the villainous tyrant Doflamingo!

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 22 [1280x720 x265 AAC][5FC46535].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 23
episodes.title: Bird Cage
episodes.description: Sabo makes a risky move to end the championship battle, and Luffy hurries to free Law. Doflamingo's apparent defeat has thrown Dressrosa into chaos, but he may have a trick or two left up his sleeve.

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 23 [1280x720 x265 AAC][5A38EC3B].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 24
episodes.title: Executive Officer Pica
episodes.description: Doflamingo announces the rules for his deadly game with the highest bounty reserved for… Usopp! As Luffy and co. head toward the palace, Fujitora stands in their way, and Pica emerges in town to change the stakes of the game.

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 24 [1280x720 x265 AAC][11DA7BCB].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 25
episodes.title: Onward!! Army of Rogues
episodes.description: The game is afoot, and Luffy finds that the dastardly Warlord has more enemies than he might realize! Strangely, an argument breaks out to decide who gets the honor of taking down Doflamingo once and for all!

files.path: [One Pace] Dressrosa 01-25 [1280x720 x264 x265 AAC]/[One Pace] Dressrosa 25 [1280x720 x265 AAC][1CADC5DC].mkv

episodes.label: Dressrosa 26
episodes.title: The State of the War
episodes.description: Law's reason for despising Doflamingo is revealed! Luffy heads toward Doflamingo's refuge, making his way through the guards, while down below Admiral Fujitora faces off against Sabo, who is now armed with a familiar fiery power!

episodes.label: Dressrosa 27
episodes.title: Battle
episodes.description: Heavy hitters from the colosseum turn from wringing each other's necks toward a unified plan, which might be just enough to give Luffy the chance he needs to make it to a final showdown with Doflamingo.

episodes.label: Dressrosa 28
episodes.title: A Man's World
episodes.description: Cavendish shares his fears that the "Birdcage" game Doflamingo is playing has been rigged all along! Meanwhile, the Tontattas are in full revolt, Zoro finally gains the upper hand against Pica, and Franky finds a way to deal with Senor Pink.

episodes.label: Dressrosa 29
episodes.title: Trump Card
episodes.description: Gladius' exploding spheres send Robin and Bartolomeo hurtling directly into Luffy and co.’s battle with some creepy dolls. Rebecca makes it to the Flower Field alone, and Sabo tastes Fujitora's full might!

episodes.label: Dressrosa 30
episodes.title: Secret Plan
episodes.description: Luffy and Law finally surmount incredible odds to land themselves in striking distance of Doflamingo. However, Sugar stands in their way, so Usopp uses Viola's clairvoyance to prepare his ammunition to take her out.

episodes.label: Dressrosa 31
episodes.title: The Operation Fruit
episodes.description: All hopes rest on Luffy and Law being able to take down Doflamingo; however, the Warlord has other plans in mind as he gives the two the fight of their lives, and he reveals his true, shocking history! Meanwhile, Sabo finds out Fujitora’s true intention.

episodes.label: Dressrosa 32
episodes.title: White Town
episodes.description: A rage born from the lies of the World Government created a child who had the will to try and kill Corazón! Law was accepted into the Doflamingo Family, but Corazón's mysterious silence hid a fact that just may have saved Law's life.

episodes.label: Dressrosa 33
episodes.title: The Island of Fate: Minion
episodes.description: Things grew stranger for Law when he learned the secret behind why Corazón feigned being mute. But the mysterious Corazón’s actions were only beginning to baffle Law when he took him on a journey to cure the youth’s disease.

episodes.label: Dressrosa 34
episodes.title: Cora
episodes.description: Corazón had finally obtained the Op Op Fruit! Doflamingo and his Family were zeroing in on Corazón and Law's whereabouts, so Corazón hid Law long enough to let him escape, even at the risk of his own life.

episodes.label: Dressrosa 35
episodes.title: Bellamy the Pirate
episodes.description: Luffy continues to fight the Doflamingo doppelganger but keeps accidentally attacking Bellamy instead. Meanwhile, the tide of battle turns against Law as painful scars from the past resurface, and Zoro gets unexpected help in his battle with Pica.

episodes.label: Dressrosa 36
episodes.title: The Spear of Elbaph and Don Sai
episodes.description: Hajrudin has been beaten down, but a fire still burns within him to pay back the favor he owes! Lao G and Don Chinjao bring their most devastating attacks to bear, but a misunderstanding caused by Baby 5 has Sai and Don Chinjao distracted.

episodes.label: Dressrosa 37
episodes.title: Cabbage and Lomeo
episodes.description: A mysterious force that resembles Cavendish menaces the battlefield! While it appears to help Bartolomeo and co. at first, it soon sets its sights on Robin! As he continues to battle Gladius, Bartolomeo is faced with an impossible dilemma.

episodes.label: Dressrosa 38
episodes.title: To Russian, with Love
episodes.description: Senor Pink and Franky continue their knock-down, drag-out, manly fight. As both are pushed to their limits, Senor Pink's tragic past is revealed! Meanwhile, Princess Mansherry's rescue hits a snag as she stubbornly refuses to leave!

episodes.label: Dressrosa 39
episodes.title: Zoro vs. Pica
episodes.description: Pica loses his temper and becomes a terrible and true force of nature. With the lives of King Riku, Usopp, and the others in the balance, Zoro must dig deep and discover a powerful technique to counter Pica's near-unstoppable onslaught.

episodes.label: Dressrosa 40
episodes.title: The Curse of Heart
episodes.description: The Tontattas finish demolishing the SMILE Factory and taking down Bellamy only enrages Luffy in his fight against Doflamingo, his anger multiplying when he finds Law's lifeless body! Meanwhile, the birdcage draws ever tighter around Dressrosa.

episodes.label: Dressrosa 41
episodes.title: In My Way
episodes.description: Law summons enough energy to speak, denouncing the Doflamingo Family executives as pawns in Doflamingo's game. Meanwhile, neither Gear Second nor Gear Third attacks are working against Doflamingo, so Luffy decides to use something stronger!

episodes.label: Dressrosa 42
episodes.title: Gear Fourth
episodes.description: The birdcage tightens its grip on Dressrosa, so Zoro sets off with a plan to stop it from slicing apart the country. Meanwhile, Luffy digs deep into his training to provide an answer born of rubber and haki to combat Doflamingo’s might.

episodes.label: Dressrosa 43
episodes.title: Gatz
episodes.description: Using Boundman drains Luffy of his haki, leaving him in need of a rest. Luckily, the colosseum combatants run interference while he recharges, and Sabo steps in at a crucial moment to defend his brother.

episodes.label: Dressrosa 44
episodes.title: Heaven and Earth
episodes.description: With just over a minute to spare, everyone in Dressrosa turns their efforts toward slowing the birdcage. Meanwhile, Rebecca, under the control of Doflamingo, advances to attack Viola, and a hero’s recovery cannot come soon enough!

episodes.label: Dressrosa 45
episodes.title: Prostration
episodes.description: The people of Dressrosa shed tears of joy as they remember the hardships endured and the actions taken to free them. As they beg King Riku to resume the crown, Admiral Fujitora shocks onlookers with an unexpected display of humility.

episodes.label: Dressrosa 46
episodes.title: Sabo's Adventure
episodes.description: The combatants in the battle for Dressrosa can finally begin to recoup, but those who stay awake are treated to the story of how Sabo joined the Revolutionary Army and how he reunited with his brother Luffy at the colosseum.

episodes.label: Dressrosa 47
episodes.title: Soldier's Conviction
episodes.description: Major players in the Marines arrive to search Dressrosa for the Straw Hats, and Rebecca's history is whitewashed with a cover story. Luffy and the others make a mad dash for the east port, but not before finishing up a piece of business.

episodes.label: Dressrosa 48
episodes.title: Father and Sons
episodes.description: Law and Sengoku share memories of Corazón and the secret of Trafalgar Law's name. Luffy and the others finally make their break from the island; however, an unbelievable new chapter opens in the story of the Straw Hat Pirates!

arcs.title: Zou
arcs.description: Zou cannot be reached by conventional means, nor is it easy to enter once one finds it. Within its secretive walls lie the Mink Tribe, and the Straw Hats soon discover that the people of Zou hold a piece of the puzzle that unlocks the mysteries of the world.

episodes.label: Zou 01
episodes.title: Zou
episodes.description: The mysterious island of Zou approaches in the distance, obscured by fog. When the haze clears, what greets the Straw Hats is beyond anyone’s expectations! Luffy and co. find the Sunny nearby, but the rest of the crew has already disembarked.

episodes.label: Zou 02
episodes.title: The Minks
episodes.description: The mysterious "island" may hold more danger than was bargained for, as Luffy and co. learn they are not alone! Luffy pushes deeper into the mysterious forest, but he is treading territory where he is not welcome.

episodes.label: Zou 03
episodes.title: At Rightflank Fortress
episodes.description: Luffy and co. ride out the rain-ruption and learn of its vital role in maintaining life on Zou. As they continue toward the fortress, they learn more about the mysterious minks, and are finally reunited with the others.

episodes.label: Zou 04
episodes.title: Duke Inuarashi and Master Nekomamushi
episodes.description: The Straw Hats finally meet the daytime ruler of this strange land. They learn more about the battle that took place here and discover the mysterious system by which the island is ruled.

episodes.label: Zou 05
episodes.title: The Curly Hat Pirates Arrive
episodes.description: While they put up a good fight, the minks were not able to subdue Jack. In the aftermath of Jack's deadly attack, Chopper and Sanji rushed in to save the fallen minks and enlisted the help of Caesar to overcome the lingering gas problem.

episodes.label: Zou 06
episodes.title: Tea Party Invitation
episodes.description: The mystery of Sanji's disappearance only deepens as Luffy learns that Big Mom’s lackeys caught up with him and offered him an invitation from one of the Four Emperors that simply could not be refused.

episodes.label: Zou 07
episodes.title: Let's Go See Master Nekomamushi
episodes.description: Being separated from one of his crew is more than Luffy is willing to tolerate! The pirates make their way toward the nighttime ruler to find out more about their friend's disappearance.

episodes.label: Zou 08
episodes.title: Raizo of the Mist
episodes.description: Revelations abound as the true nature of the men from Wano and their relationship with the minks is revealed, and Momonosuke's role is greater than any had imagined. But even more shocking is the visage of a real ninja!

episodes.label: Zou 09
episodes.title: Momonosuke, Heir of the Kozuki Family
episodes.description: More mysteries of the Kozuki Clan are revealed, and its retainers propose an alliance to help topple one of the Four Emperors: Kaido of the Beast Pirates! But first, Luffy has some important Straw Hat business to attend to.

episodes.label: Zou 10
episodes.title: Understood
episodes.description: The Straw Hats divide and conquer: one group to go save Sanji, and the other to Wano! But just before their departure, the tremendous elephant quakes as Jack’s fleet launches an aggressive attack on the monstrous Zunesha.

arcs.title: Whole Cake Island
arcs.description: Luffy will not sail the seas without his cook, so he stubbornly goes after Sanji to Whole Cake Island. However, knocking on an emperor's door is easier said than done.

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 01
episodes.title: A World Abuzz
episodes.description: Luffy's team—plus a stowaway—sets out from Zou on their way to win back Sanji. Meanwhile, the leading families and leaders of the world make their way to the Holy Land, Mary Geoise, for a pivotal round table conference.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][823-824] Whole Cake Island 01 [720p][3F24A1D8].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 02
episodes.title: 0 and 4
episodes.description: Without Sanji to properly identify safe and edible food, Luffy gets a stomach full of poisonous fish! With no antidotes on board, the Straw Hats must rely on a couple of mysterious—yet somehow familiar—passersby for help.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][825-826] Whole Cake Island 02 [720p][6FFCB482].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 03
episodes.title: Totto Land
episodes.description: Arriving on Cacao Island, Luffy and Chopper are in heaven as everything before their eyes is edible. There, the Straw Hats encounter Sanji’s betrothed, Pudding, but when they challenge her for Sanji's heart, her answer is truly shocking.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][827-828] Whole Cake Island 03 [720p][3F6633B5].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 04
episodes.title: Pirate Emperor, Charlotte Linlin
episodes.description: Big Mom ravages Whole Cake Island in search of sweets, and while a familiar face across the waters has just what she needs, he also brings ill tidings. As the Straw Hats draw closer to the island, Pedro shares his sordid past in Big Mom’s territory.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][829-830] Whole Cake Island 04 [720p][02C6FC2B].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 05
episodes.title: Adventure in the Mysterious Forest
episodes.description: Luffy’s group makes its way toward Sanji, only to be distracted by the endless supply of sweets and a second Luffy. Before they realize it, they are lost in the Seducing Woods! Meanwhile, Sanji confronts his older brother.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][831-832] Whole Cake Island 05 [720p][4CF30353].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 06
episodes.title: Vinsmoke Judge
episodes.description: Sanji faces his father in a duel as the wounds of his childhood are laid bare! Meanwhile, Luffy falls for the illusions of the forest, and Big Mom has Caesar at her whims, ready to use him to continue her maniacal pursuits.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][833-834] Whole Cake Island 06 [720p][410C8F0C].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 07
episodes.title: Lola's Vivre Card
episodes.description: The mysterious half-buried man comes clean about his identity, but this must all be put aside when one of Big Mom's most powerful commanders comes calling. Nami's past exploits, however, hold the key to keeping the baddies at bay.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][835-836] Whole Cake Island 07 [720p][FC2376A1].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 08
episodes.title: Luffy vs. Commander Cracker
episodes.description: Luffy squares off against a commander of Big Mom, Charlotte Cracker, whose powers may prove more troublesome than they appear. Meanwhile, Brook and Pedro infiltrate Whole Cake Island and work out a plan to avoid getting caught.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][837-838] Whole Cake Island 08 [720p][31018FCB].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 09
episodes.title: The Iron Mask
episodes.description: Sanji challenges his entire family, but they have effectively ensured he follows their wedding scheme. The truth of Germa's power and Vinsmoke Judge’s dark history is also revealed. Meanwhile, Nami has recruited the homies and challenges Cracker!

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][839-840] Whole Cake Island 09 [720p][94E3481F].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 10
episodes.title: To the East Blue
episodes.description: Sanji’s tragic history included a rare moment of compassion that was his only chance at escape, but even then, his father’s cruelty haunted him. In the present, Reiju helps Sanji straighten himself out before he meets with his fiancée.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][841-842] Whole Cake Island 10 [720p][E123D314].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 11
episodes.title: Luffy vs. Sanji
episodes.description: Luffy finishes off Cracker and finally catches up with Sanji, but the Straw Hats’ cook seems far from thrilled about the reunion. A heartbreaking duel commences, but a steadfast Luffy makes a solemn vow to his friend and crewmate.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][843-844] Whole Cake Island 11 [720p][8B5E1006].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 12
episodes.title: Forces of Rage
episodes.description: Luffy stands his ground and waits for Sanji to return, but as the vengeful army washes over him, only a true friend can step in to help. At Big Mom’s castle, Sanji and Pudding discuss their marriage and come to a startling conclusion!

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][845-846] Whole Cake Island 12 [720p][36D0F622].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 13
episodes.title: Luffy and Big Mom
episodes.description: Pedro creates a diversion for Brook to put his soulful plan into action. Meanwhile, the captured Luffy continues to goad Big Mom, and Pudding has the beginnings of rebellion stirring up inside her.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][847-848] Whole Cake Island 13 [720p][D9EEB564].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 14
episodes.title: A Ray of Light
episodes.description: When Pudding arrives to meet the captured Luffy and Nami, their hopefulness suddenly turns to shock! To make matters worse, Brook comes face to face with Big Mom herself! At the risk of his own well-being, Luffy desperately tries to free himself.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][849-850] Whole Cake Island 14 [720p][CCCBEFC0].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 15
episodes.title: Germa's Failure
episodes.description: Things are looking grim for Luffy and Nami until an unexpected ally appears. Elsewhere, Sanji confronts his sister about what Pudding plans to do and learns the powerful secret of their mother's undying love.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][851-852] Whole Cake Island 15 [720p][0E2022E4].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 16
episodes.title: Not Here
episodes.description: Luffy fights through more obstacles in search of Sanji, and Brook hears Big Mom's plan firsthand as she shares her intentions with Pudding. While Big Mom's agents believe most of the Straw Hats to be under their control, Mont d'Or has his doubts.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][853-854] Whole Cake Island 16 [720p][A8E42FE1].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 17
episodes.title: Liar
episodes.description: Nami and co. finally locate Brook using the Mirro-world, but he is in the most inopportune of places! Meanwhile, Luffy is waylaid on his way back to the rendezvous, and Jinbe shares the awful truth about the wedding with the other Straw Hat pirates.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][855-856] Whole Cake Island 17 [720p][0CF96D5A].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 18
episodes.title: Rook
episodes.description: Jinbe tells the Straw Hats about Capone “Gang” Bege and proposes a shocking plan to take down Big Mom! But before they are granted an audience with Bege, they must make themselves presentable.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][857-858] Whole Cake Island 18 [720p][3F5E7FD3].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 19
episodes.title: Emperor Assassination Plan
episodes.description: The plan for Big Mom’s assassination is all set. Sanji heads back to his room to avoid suspicion, but Mont d’Or is hot on his trail. The day arrives, and guests from the criminal underground pour in in droves, some with their own agendas to settle.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][859-860] Whole Cake Island 19 [720p][0F125E00].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 20
episodes.title: Veteran Actor
episodes.description: Final preparations abound, plans come together, and Sanji meets his bride on the altar. As the veil is lifted off Pudding's face, emotions run high, and the chaos begins! As the proverbial icing on the cake, all hell breaks loose as Luffy charges in!

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][861-862] Whole Cake Island 20 [720p][4F38961B].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 21
episodes.title: The Honorable
episodes.description: The wedding and the precious cake crumble to pieces around Big Mom as a slew of Luffys wreak havoc. The chaos pushes Big Mom past the edge of sanity, so her children make a move against Germa while Pudding takes aim at Sanji.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][863-864] Whole Cake Island 21 [720p][5FDB702D].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 22
episodes.title: Hey, Mother
episodes.description: Luffy dashes toward Big Mom to show her the broken portrait again, and Sanji attempts to free his family. Here, Big Mom’s tragic and sad history is revealed: from the very beginning, Big Mom's voracious hunger has brought her into conflict with others.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][865-866] Whole Cake Island 22 [720p][39D94718].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 23
episodes.title: HAPPY BIRTHDAY
episodes.description: A young Linlin managed to enrage the giants of Elbaph, but Mother Carmel begged for clemency on her behalf. After Carmel’s mysterious disappearance, Linlin fell in with a new cohort and found her reason to go on living.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][867-868] Whole Cake Island 23 [720p][437F9E8D].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 24
episodes.title: Under Siege
episodes.description: The Straw Hats and Germa 66 become cornered in Bege's stronghold, and the full might of the Big Mom Pirates is pinning them down! It is only a matter of time before their defenses crack, so they take the only way out and make a break for it.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][869-870] Whole Cake Island 24 [720p][6E422CFB].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 25
episodes.title: You Can Do It, Caesar!!
episodes.description: Caesar flies the entire alliance, still inside Bege, out of the venue! However, the full might of the Big Mom Pirates proves too much. The alliance’s annihilation is imminent, but something shakes the playing field.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][870-872] Whole Cake Island 25 [720p][32CC4AB9].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 26
episodes.title: Become My Servant
episodes.description: The Straw Hats continue their mad dash to the Sunny, and Pudding puts her plan to rebuild the cake into action. As Zeus pursues the Straw Hats, Nami keeps him occupied with a shocking surprise that might stop Big Mom in her tracks!

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][873-874] Whole Cake Island 26 [720p][71827EF0].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 27
episodes.title: A Woman's Honor
episodes.description: Big Mom is relentless in her pursuit of the Straw Hats. Elsewhere, the plan to recreate the wedding cake progresses while Pudding’s unpredictable heart confuses everyone, including herself.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][875-876] Whole Cake Island 27 [720p][2CDA8E9D].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 28
episodes.title: Mink Pedro, Captain of the Guardians
episodes.description: Sandwiched between Big Mom and her advancing fleet, the only hope left to the Sunny is to blast right through it all. Meanwhile, Pedro comes face-to-face with his past and does what he must to ensure the success of his friends.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][877-878] Whole Cake Island 28 [720p][22B16322].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 29
episodes.title: Zero Escape
episodes.description: In the Mirro-world, Luffy confronts the formidable Charlotte Katakuri, Big Mom’s strongest child. Meanwhile, Pudding and Sanji arrive at Cacao Island to remake the cake, but they bicker like a married couple the whole time.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][879-880] Whole Cake Island 29 [720p][270A4ABD].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 30
episodes.title: Wave Room
episodes.description: Nami and Luffy discuss a rendezvous point while the others break the mirrors on the Sunny. Little do they know their plan is overheard, and Luffy’s grueling battle against Katakuri—haki vs. haki, rubber vs. mochi—intensifies.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][881-883] Whole Cake Island 30 [720p][ABB0AC56].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 31
episodes.title: Merienda
episodes.description: Katakuri retires to his sanctuary to enjoy a merienda—a sweet chance to replenish his haki! But he is not the only one munching away. A mochi mountain has crushed Luffy, and he has found a delectable way to escape.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][883-884] Whole Cake Island 31 [720p][529AE554].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 32
episodes.title: Way of Life
episodes.description: When Chiffon comes under attack, Sanji must choose between defending her or revealing his whereabouts to his enemies. Elsewhere, Luffy uses Charlotte Brûlée as a human shield to avoid the wrath of Big Mom.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][885-886] Whole Cake Island 32 [720p][8313ECE3].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 33
episodes.title: Lion
episodes.description: Sanji and Bege contend with Charlotte Oven, who boils the sea itself! Meanwhile, a vicious pincer attack bears down on the Straw Hats, but Carrot draws on a deep power within and springs to action under the light of the full moon.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][887-888] Whole Cake Island 33 [720p][6FBBD350].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 34
episodes.title: Unknown Mama
episodes.description: Wielding Napoleon and backed by Zeus and Prometheus, Big Mom wreaks havoc on the Sunny. As the Straw Hats try to kick out the Emperor, their ship catches fire! But then, Jinbe steps up to the plate to take a swing.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][889-891] Whole Cake Island 34 [720p][A3939979].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 35
episodes.title: They Believe in Me
episodes.description: The cake is finally brought before Big Mom. With the end of her vicious rampage in sight, the Straw Hats may just get their chance to flee! Big Mom's crew is forced to decide who to attack, and Luffy grows ever closer to mastering his haki.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][891-893] Whole Cake Island 35 [720p][1753F7D1].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 36
episodes.title: Pirate Luffy vs. Commander Katakuri
episodes.description: Desiring revenge after complete embarrassment, Big Mom’s children band together to smash the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, Luffy and Katakuri are locked in a duel to end all duels, where each blow could be the last.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][892-895] Whole Cake Island 36 [720p][3AF37912].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 37
episodes.title: One Last Thing
episodes.description: Luffy's dramatic battle finally draws to a close, and a whole host of the Big Mom Pirates watch the last mirror to see who will come through.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][896-897] Whole Cake Island 37 [720p][3C58DD41].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 38
episodes.title: BAD END MUSICAL
episodes.description: Sanji tries his best to save himself and his captain. Now, the fate of Totto Land rests on the taste of the wedding cake! With the help of Germa and the Sun Pirates, the Straw Hats see their chance to escape!

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][898-900] Whole Cake Island 38 [720p][E9317CBD].mkv

episodes.label: Whole Cake Island 39
episodes.title: END ROLL
episodes.description: As the Big Mom Pirate fleet approaches, Jinbe makes a crucial decision. At a great cost of energy and life, the Straw Hats make it out of Totto Land. Left behind in their wake are allies, friends, and would-be lovers.

files.path: [One Pace][823-902] Whole Cake Island [720p]/[One Pace][901-902] Whole Cake Island 39 [720p][172F5F20].mkv

arcs.title: Reverie
arcs.description: Every four years, the leaders of the world gather at the Holy Land to discuss a mutually agreed upon path for the government. During this particular Reverie, many parties with their own agendas arrive... and some are uninvited.

episodes.label: Reverie 01
episodes.title: The Fifth Emperor
episodes.description: Luffy’s reputation grows as all eyes look toward the Straw Hats’ next move. Meanwhile, the royals of the world make their way to the Reverie, but their absence welcomes a raid by a vicious band of pirates on the Kingdom of Lulusia.

episodes.label: Reverie 02
episodes.title: A Beautiful World
episodes.description: At New Marineford, Fleet Admiral Sakazuki hears the news about Luffy while nobles from around the world gather for the Reverie! At the Red Line, Garp is escorting King Neptune’s family when Shirahoshi sees the surface world for the first time.

episodes.label: Reverie 03
episodes.title: The Empty Throne
episodes.description: As the Reverie commences, Emperors Big Mom and Kaido both set their sights on Luffy! Meanwhile, a mysterious outsider visits the highest authority in the world, and the Revolutionary Army confirms its desire to save Kuma.

arcs.title: Wano
arcs.description: The Straw Hats finally regroup in Wano to carry out theirs and their allies' ultimate goal: to see to the Emperor Kaido's downfall and restore the Kozuki family to its rightful place of power.

episodes.label: Wano 01
episodes.title: Onward to Wano
episodes.description: Luffy and the others see familiar faces in a newspaper article about the Reverie right as they approach Wano. However, this dangerous and foreboding land is as inaccessible as it is mysterious, with the sea itself acting as a barrier!

episodes.label: Wano 02
episodes.title: Seppuku
episodes.description: A mysterious country, a rampaging slasher, an ancient samurai ritual of seppuku—and Zoro in the crosshairs! Stranded alone on the beach, Luffy tries to gather his bearings only to be confronted by some dangerous local fauna.

episodes.label: Wano 03
episodes.title: Amigasa Village
episodes.description: Otama recounts her promise to Ace while Luffy rushes her to medical attention. But just as they reach the wasteland, a familiar face comes into view, and Kaido's underlings show up, too!

episodes.label: Wano 04
episodes.title: Tsuru Returns the Favor
episodes.description: Luffy and Zoro are stalled by Hawkins, but their fortune looks bright when a woman guides them to a teahouse. There, they find an herbal remedy for the river poison that Otama drank, while old acquaintances look on from a distance.

episodes.label: Wano 05
episodes.title: Okobore Town
episodes.description: Otama is kidnapped by Kaido’s gifters and taken to a flourishing settlement called Bakura Town where a creepy-looking headliner was expecting her. Luffy, Zoro, and the samurai Okiku rush to her rescue.

episodes.label: Wano 06
episodes.title: Wano's Grand Sumo Tournament
episodes.description: Luffy challenges Urashima, the strongest yokozuna in Wano, to a sumo match! However, Urashima is willing to resort to illegal moves. Meanwhile, Holdem tells Otama that he must punish her for a crime she committed.

episodes.label: Wano 07
episodes.title: The Provisions Ship
episodes.description: Luffy and co. finally find Otama hanging from the mouth of a lion in Holdem’s stomach. Luffy prepares to save Otama from Kaido’s lackey, and elsewhere, a mysterious figure confronts Basil Hawkins.

episodes.label: Wano 08
episodes.title: The Ruins of Oden Castle
episodes.description: Zoro and the others dash out of Bakura Town on the treasure ship filled with food! Luffy catches up to them, and together, they distribute food and water to the people of Okobore Town. Later, Law takes them to the ruins of a hilltop castle.

episodes.label: Wano 09
episodes.title: I Love Oden
episodes.description: Kin’emon tells Luffy and the others about how Kozuki Oden brought peace to Kuri and became its daimyo. However, he was set up by Kaido and Orochi. When Kin’emon ran to save Oden’s wife, she revealed a shocking truth.

episodes.label: Wano 10
episodes.title: Shutenmaru
episodes.description: Ashura Doji, a.k.a Shutenmaru, is one of the allies Kin’emon wants to search for, and he leads a raid on Okobore Town to steal the food that Luffy brought. This unrest prompts the drunken Kaido to fly above Okobore Town in his dragon form.

episodes.label: Wano 11
episodes.title: Emperor Kaido vs. Luffy
episodes.description: Infuriated by Kaido’s violence toward his allies, Luffy lands blow after blow on the drunken Emperor. When he activates Gear Fourth and launches even more powerful attacks, Kaido fights back. Law tries to rescue Luffy but is interrupted by Hawkins.

episodes.label: Wano 12
episodes.title: Hah
episodes.description: Luffy is sent to a great mine where prisoners must endure harsh, forced labor. There, he has an unexpected reunion. Meanwhile, Okiku rushes to the ruins of Oden Castle to confirm the safety of the Straw Hats and the others.

episodes.label: Wano 13
episodes.title: Void
episodes.description: Perona prepares to leave Gloom Island after she finds out that her captain, Gecko Moria, is still alive. Meanwhile, Moria raids the infamous Pirate Island with his zombie army to retrieve his old friend from Blackbeard.

episodes.label: Wano 14
episodes.title: Otoko the Kamuro
episodes.description: In the Prisoner Mining Camp, Luffy’s and Kid’s competition garners the wrong kind of attention. Meanwhile, Sanji’s soba becomes immensely popular, but gang members disturb his business and knock over a customer’s bowl.

episodes.label: Wano 15
episodes.title: Oiran Komurasaki Arrives
episodes.description: Wano’s top courtesan—the oiran Komurasaki—is in procession and slowly makes her way to Orochi Palace. While everyone is fascinated by the oiran, some seeking vengeance get in her way.

episodes.label: Wano 16
episodes.title: Soba Mask
episodes.description: In the Flower Capital, a member of the Beast Pirates, Page One, attacks every soba restaurant in search of Sanji. The Straw Hat’s cook faces Kaido’s headliner while using Germa’s device for the first time to hide his identity.

episodes.label: Wano 17
episodes.title: The Shogun and the Oiran
episodes.description: At the shogun’s banquet, the oiran’s child attendant Otoko bursts with laughter and cannot stop. The enraged Shogun Orochi attacks her, but an unexpected person stands in his way. To end the to-do, Kyoshiro takes matters into his own hands.

episodes.label: Wano 18
episodes.title: Hyogoro the Flower
episodes.description: Chopper’s group is off to rescue Luffy from the Prisoner Mining Camp, but the Straw Hat captain is in a bit of a bind. While Luffy tries to save old man Hyo from execution, Queen the Plague comes to visit the prison.

episodes.label: Wano 19
episodes.title: Gyukimaru of Bandit's Bridge
episodes.description: Luffy fights in an endless sumo match to protect old man Hyo, and Nami, Robin, and Shinobu are cornered as Hawkins raids the bathhouse. Elsewhere, Zoro faces a samurai who accuses him of stealing Shusui, but their duel is interrupted by a woman’s scream.

episodes.label: Wano 20
episodes.title: A Woman's Secret
episodes.description: The wounded Zoro wakes up to find out the shocking identity of the woman he saved and is told the unbelievable tale of twenty years earlier. Meanwhile, Luffy’s “training” is not getting anywhere, but a surprising person gives him his first lesson.

episodes.label: Wano 21
episodes.title: Sparks of Rebellion
episodes.description: The smiling man Tonoyasu leaves all who met him mystified, what with his familiar terms of address and his shocking knowledge of the rebellion. In Udon prison, Luffy continues his new haki training, and during a brief respite, Raizo appears before him.

episodes.label: Wano 22
episodes.title: Shimotsuki Yasuie, the Daimyo of Hakumai
episodes.description: Tonoyasu has been strung up and awaits his inevitable execution while all of Wano is shocked to find out who he really is. The citizens cry out in outrage, and the doomed man raises his voice in a final act of rebellion against Shogun Orochi.

episodes.label: Wano 23
episodes.title: SMILE
episodes.description: The truth behind the smiles of the Ebisu villagers finally comes to light, the Shogun and Kaido’s plan revealed! And in Udon Luffy and Hyo are shocked to see Captain Kid return in chains alongside a smiling newcomer.

episodes.label: Wano 24
episodes.title: Olin
episodes.description: A very big and hungry visitor arrives at Udon looking for Superstar Queen’s sweet red bean oshiruko, and Rasetsu town is in a full-blown riot with the Straw Hats at the center!

episodes.label: Wano 25
episodes.title: Queen vs. Olin
episodes.description: To Chopper’s surprise, the kind and sweet Olin—a.k.a. Emperor Big Mom—has proven her power to be just as devastating as ever. Olin’s hunger pangs just about reach their limit, and Luffy must act quickly before his mechanical collar executes him.

episodes.label: Wano 26
episodes.title: Mummy
episodes.description: Babanuki unleashes an unthinkable weapon, and a mysterious figure emerges from a forbidden cell to save Luffy. Then, Old Man Hyo emboldens Raizo and Kiku to reveal their true identities and give the desperate prisoners some much-needed hope.

episodes.label: Wano 27
episodes.title: A Soldier's Dream
episodes.description: In Udon, an unexpected person stands up to bring the prisoners renewed hope! Elsewhere, Zoro and Hiyori are pursued by ninja, Orochi is told of Trafalgar Law’s capture, and the people of the Flower Capital prepare for the upcoming Fire Festival.

episodes.label: Wano 28
episodes.title: RAMPAGE
episodes.description: Kanjuro takes Yasuie’s body to bury him with Oden, and Robin, Usopp, and Brook cleverly pass a checkpoint. While Big Mom and Kaido clash at Onigashima, Old Man Hyo finds his former allies in Udon. And in Ringo, Zoro faces Gyukimaru once more.

episodes.label: Wano 29
episodes.title: Once a Fox
episodes.description: Zoro runs after the warrior-monk who took Shusui, and Kawamatsu shares his memory of a fox that was guarding the graves in Ringo. Soon, they find a room filled with swords, and Hiyori tells Zoro to give Shusui back to the land of Wano.

episodes.label: Wano 30
episodes.title: Enma
episodes.description: As the day of the raid approaches, Kin’emon discusses the plan, and at Onigashima, Kaido and Big Mom make a surprising declaration! In the meantime, Zoro is stunned by Enma’s demonic power and its ties to him.

episodes.label: Wano 31
episodes.title: Big News
episodes.description: The resolution that passed during the Reverie and the incidents surrounding the conference stun people all over the world and corner the Seven Warlords of the Sea. Meanwhile, Captain Koby secretly contacts someone currently in Wano.

episodes.label: Wano 32
episodes.title: Ultimate
episodes.description: Admiral Issho and Fleet Admiral Sakazuki argue over the abolition of the Seven Warlord system and the alliance between two Emperors. Meanwhile, ex-Fleet Admiral Sengoku teaches the young Marines about the legendary Rocks Pirates.

episodes.label: Wano 33
episodes.title: The Designated Port
episodes.description: On the day of the Fire Festival, Orochi heads for Onigashima where a big banquet is being held, and the Red Scabbards meet at the Tokage Port rendezvous point. However, Kin'emon and his compatriots are stunned that none of their allies are there.

episodes.label: Wano 34
episodes.title: The Day of the Mountain God
episodes.description: Forty-one years ago, Oden had not yet earned the respect of everyone, but when the angry mountain god almost killed Kin’emon, Oden stepped in. Still, disavowed by his father, Oden journeyed around the country, gathering followers as he went.

episodes.label: Wano 35
episodes.title: Daimyo and Retainers
episodes.description: Oden transformed Kuri and was made Daimyo over it. He also met a kappa fishman and two minks, who soon became his followers. Kin’emon and the other vassals took Yasuie's strong words to heart and began transforming themselves for their lord.

episodes.label: Wano 36
episodes.title: Oden's Adventure
episodes.description: As Oden began his voyage, he was in awe of all the things that he had never seen before, and for the first time in his life, he became a wanted person and made the headlines, catching the eye of a high-profile figure.

episodes.label: Wano 37
episodes.title: Roger and Whitebeard
episodes.description: Back in Wano, the Shogun Sukiyaki seemed to fall critically ill and named Orochi proxy Shogun. Meanwhile, Whitebeard's crew made landfall where the Roger Pirates were fighting against the Marines on the other side of the island.

episodes.label: Wano 38
episodes.title: Roger's Adventure
episodes.description: Oden visits Wano and sees his retainers for the first time in years, but he immediately returns to the sea and leaves his family behind in their care. After stopping at Zou for the final red poneglyph, the Roger Pirates finally make it to the last island.

episodes.label: Wano 39
episodes.title: Fool of a Lord
episodes.description: The Roger Pirates have completed their grand adventure, and the King of the Pirates is born! Gol D. Roger disbands his merry crew and Oden returns triumphant to his homeland of Wano. However, a sinister surprise awaits him upon his rightful throne.

episodes.label: Wano 40
episodes.title: Oden Was Meant to Boil
episodes.description: Oden and his retainers are sentenced to death by boiling in a pot. Oden asks for a chance to survive, and an amused Kaido accepts. Meanwhile, Shinobu reveals to surprised citizens what Oden had been doing to save the country.

episodes.label: Wano 41
episodes.title: The Kozuki Clan
episodes.description: After Kaido attacks Oden's family in their castle, Toki uses her power one last time and makes a prophecy to the people of Wano. Twenty years later, the raid on Onigashima is imminent, but the sting of betrayal hits hardest on the eve of triumph!

episodes.label: Wano 42
episodes.title: Kin'emon's Clever Ruse
episodes.description: As the Scabbards and their comrades struggle to rescue the kidnapped Momo, two unforseen allies join the fight: one thought long gone 20 years ago and another pledging his loyalty to Luffy.

episodes.label: Wano 43
episodes.title: The Party's Off!!!
episodes.description: The triumphant return of Jinbe sees him officially join the Straw Hats as their helmsman. As the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance plans the first steps of the raid on Onigashima, the Straw Hats look for a way to celebrate their new crewmate.

episodes.label: Wano 44
episodes.title: A Family Matter
episodes.description: The raid on Onigashima kicks off with Law's group sneaking around the back and Luffy's group moving straight through the front door, cleverly disguised as the enemy itself! Meanwhile, Kaido holds an audience with the Soaring Six.

episodes.label: Wano 45
episodes.title: Fighting Music
episodes.description: Luffy and Zoro are outed by Scratchman Apoo, and Queen announces that anyone who catches them will get a coveted promotion. Elsewhere, Kin’emon's infiltration strategy evolves while Big Mom's children are greeted by a surprise party crasher.

episodes.label: Wano 46
episodes.title: Thunder
episodes.description: Kanjuro arrives before Orochi and Kaido with Momonosuke in tow and Big Mom chases Chopper and Usopp. Meanwhile, Luffy butts heads with Page One's doting sister Ulti, but unbeknownst to Straw Hat, he's also about to meet Kaido's runaway son...

episodes.label: Wano 47
episodes.title: My Bible
episodes.description: Yamato notices something in Luffy that reminds him of someone from long ago. When Orochi declares he will execute Momonosuke, Kaido adds to the excitement with a big announcement, and at the rear of the mansion, the Red Scabbards reunite!

episodes.label: Wano 48
episodes.title: Retainers of Glory
episodes.description: The stage is set, the curtain is drawn, and the Red Scabbards approach their target of 20 years. Luffy and Yamato burst onto the Performance Floor with a bang, and Wano's samurai make the opening attack for the long-anticipated battle.

episodes.label: Wano 49
episodes.title: I Can't Imagine Losing
episodes.description: Momonosuke is finally freed, and King and Queen must contend with the incursion of samurai and pirates on the Performance Floor. Big Mom is swiftly removed from the situation, and the Straw Hat pirates gather once more as the assualt kicks off!

episodes.label: Wano 50
episodes.title: Army of One
episodes.description: Luffy invokes memories of the Straw Hats pirates' battle against Oars as he topples one of the gargantuan Numbers... with the help of an unforeseen ally! Meanwhile, Queen readies a demonic secret weapon that will ice over the samurai invasion.

episodes.label: Wano 51
episodes.title: Remnants
episodes.description: Yamato continues to pursue Momonosuke as Shinobu scurries with him through the halls of Onigashima. Meanwhile, the battle on the roof intensifies as the Scabbards fight with honor to prove they are not just cheap imitations of the great Kozuki Oden.

episodes.label: Wano 52
episodes.title: A Kunoichi's Oath
episodes.description: Friend and foe alike fall victim to Queen's chilling virus, and Apoo is playing keep-away with the vial of antibodies. Perospero and Marco's brief alliance is shattered, and so are Nami and Usopp's skulls as they face down Ulti and Page One.

episodes.label: Wano 53
episodes.title: Flame Clouds
episodes.description: In the midst of the chaos on the Performance Floor, Chopper learns the secret behind Queen's latest plague. Meanwhile, Big Mom reaches the roof, Sanji hurries in the name of love, and Zoro watches as something falls from the hole in the ceiling.

episodes.label: Wano 54
episodes.title: The Sake I Brewed to Drink With You
episodes.description: Sanji gets himself caught in Black Maria's web, Jinbe faces Who's-Who, and Yamato tells of the time Ace visited Onigashima. Elsewhere, Marco joins the fray on the Performance Floor to help soothe the infected and to offer Zoro a ride.

episodes.label: Wano 55
episodes.title: Straw Hat Luffy
episodes.description: Yamato recalls learning the sad truth about Ace, but remembers what he said about his brother, Straw Hat Luffy. As Kaido and Big Mom join forces on the roof of Onigashima, they are faced with the biggest names of the Worst Generation...

episodes.label: Wano 56
episodes.title: The Battle of Monsters on Onigashima
episodes.description: It's a fight to remember! Five members from the Worst Generation—Monkey D. Luffy, Eustass "Captain" Kid, Trafalgar Law, Roronoa Zoro, and Killer—facing off against two Emperors—Kaido, "King of the Beasts," and Charlotte Linlin, a.k.a. Big Mom!

episodes.label: Wano 57
episodes.title: Millet Dumplings
episodes.description: Luffy momentarily topples Kaido with Gear Fourth, but the effort depletes his haki. Inside Onigashima, Tama's plan to rid the country of Kaido and Orochi unfolds as she feeds the gifters her special millet dumplings and turns the tide of battle!

episodes.label: Wano 58
episodes.title: The Honorable Hyogoro "the Flower"
episodes.description: Sanji shocks all when he is heard begging for his life and calling for a certain crewmate to rescue him. Meanwhile, Momo is forced out of his hiding spot while his allies and Marco struggle to keep the enemy from interrupting Chopper's work.

episodes.label: Wano 59
episodes.title: Leader of the Mt. Atama Thieves, Ashura Doji
episodes.description: The brilliant Dr. Chopper creates a virus of his own to counteract Queen's Ice Oni bioweapon, and as the Red Scabbards regroup after their utter defeat at the hands of Kaido, they are unexpectedly met by a familiar face from 20 years ago.

episodes.label: Wano 60
episodes.title: Conqueror's Haki
episodes.description: As Orochi's fire within Onigashima begins to spread, the battle between the Emperors and the Worst Generation heats up as well. Zoro pushes his skills to the limit, Big Mom topples over the edge, and Luffy advances his haki to the next level.

episodes.label: Wano 61
episodes.title: The Sweet Bean Code
episodes.description: The sound of lightning rumbles as Big Mom prepares to test out her newest Homie. Meanwhile, down on the second floor, Usopp, Nami, Tama and Komachiyo continue trying (and failing) to get a very angry Page One off their tail.

episodes.label: Wano 62
episodes.title: Anarchy in the BM
episodes.description: Things are heating up on the second floor as an enraged Ulti prepares to attack Big Mom. Elsewhere on that same floor, Sanji runs, jumps and kicks his way through seemingly endless waves of gifters and pleasures, a heavily bandaged (and very sleepy) Zoro in tow.

arcs.title: Egghead
arcs.description: Futuristic tech, giant alien monsters, battle robots, superhuman clones... Who are all these people calling themselves Dr. Vegapunk, and why is the government after one of their own?

episodes.label: Egghead 01
episodes.title: New Emperors
episodes.description: The Straw Hats rave over new bounties, and Crocodile and Mihawk pay Buggy a visit. Elsewhere, Dragon and his revolutionaries are shocked when they read about Sabo in the news, and an old comrade returns, a shell of his former self.

episodes.label: Egghead 02
episodes.title: The Matter Involving Captain Koby
episodes.description: The three-way struggle between the Marines, the Blackbeard Pirates, and the Kuja Pirates comes to an end when an unexpected figure shows up. On the Sunny, the Straw Hats talk about the recent incidents around the world and Luffy’s words surprise everyone.

episodes.label: Egghead 03
episodes.title: Future Island Egghead
episodes.description: Sabo contacts his comrades, which prompts a certain eavesdropper to take action against an entire island nation! Meanwhile, Luffy, Chopper, and Jinbe alongside a mysterious girl become separated from the rest of the Straw Hats when a giant shark attacks.

episodes.label: Egghead 04
episodes.title: Adventure in the Land of Science
episodes.description: Franky and Luffy's groups are split up, but each encounter a person claiming to be Dr. Vegapunk. On the island, Luffy and co. find convenient food and futuristic clothing, but when a pacifista shows up, Bonney reveals her shocking relationship with Kuma.

episodes.label: Egghead 05
episodes.title: The Six Vegapunks
episodes.description: Lilith takes the Sunny and its remaining crew to the laboratory in the clouds, where a new threat lurking within its corridors attacks unexpectedly. As the battle ensues, Vegapunk's satellites look on with excitement.

episodes.label: Egghead 06
episodes.title: The Will of Ohara
episodes.description: Vegapunk Shaka shares his theory about an ancient kingdom and the Void Century. He also reminisces about the foundation of Dragon's Revolutionary Army. Meanwhile, Luffy and Chopper try to activate the giant robot when something surprising happens.

episodes.label: Egghead 07
episodes.title: Punk Records
episodes.description: After Vegapunk shares his dream with Luffy's group, he asks the Straw Hat captain for a big favor. Meanwhile, CP0 ignores their lack of invitation to Egghead and get around the island defenses to make landfall.

episodes.label: Egghead 08
episodes.title: The Strongest Form of Humanity
episodes.description: As the rematch between Luffy and Lucci kicks off, Dr. Vegapunk notices something very fascinating about the Straw Hat captain's new abilities. Meanwhile, Sentomaru arrives with the latest pacifista models as a very unlikely ally to the pirates!

episodes.label: Egghead 09
episodes.title: The Weight of Memory
episodes.description: To avenge her father, Bonney chases Dr. Vegapunk through the lab, but a familiar symbol catches her eye. As she investigates, the satellites call in an unexpected favor to finally deal with CP0's rampage outside the lab.

episodes.label: Egghead 10
episodes.title: Miss Buckingham Stussy
episodes.description: Upon mysterious orders, Stussy betrays Lucci and Kaku. Lilith and Edison also hurry outside the lab to stop the rampaging seraphim. Meanwhile, the main Dr. Vegapunk goes missing, and Admiral Kizaru escorts a powerful and commanding entity toward Egghead.

episodes.label: Egghead 11
episodes.title: Labophase Death Game
episodes.description: The search for Dr. Vegapunk's main body is threatened by the deadly seraphim, only this time the satellites' orders are unable to pacify them. Faced with a tough decision, Luffy and Zoro must team up with the most unlikely of allies.

episodes.label: Egghead 12
episodes.title: Escape Limit
episodes.description: Luffy, Zoro, Lucci, and Kaku combine their might, and a chivalrous cook rescues Nami from near defeat. Meanwhile, Lilith, Usopp, and Franky are stopped in their tracks by someone very deadly, yet very cute.

episodes.label: Egghead 13
episodes.title: The Emperor's Crew, The Red Hair Pirates
episodes.description: Eustass "Captain" Kid sails in, guns blazing against Elbaph while Shanks of the Red Hair Pirates defends his crew and friends... without an ounce of mercy.

episodes.label: Egghead 14
episodes.title: The Legendary Hero
episodes.description: While Koby desperately attempts to flee Beehive, Cross Guild's bounty entices the hundreds of pirates there to hunt him down. But before they can seal his fate and claim the prize, a familiar Marine warship descends from the sky!

episodes.label: Egghead 15
episodes.title: Let's Go and Take It!!
episodes.description: While Cross Guild grows into a serious concern for the Marines, Buggy makes an impassioned speech to spur his crew into a zealous fervor. Additionally, Sabo returns to his comrades and begins his report on the events that happened at the Reverie.

episodes.label: Egghead 16
episodes.title: The Attempted Murder of a Celestial Dragon
episodes.description: During the Reverie, Sabo and Bonney met and worked together toward the same goal. King Cobra also met with the Five Elders to ask some hard questions, in the process learning the dark truth of the world.

episodes.label: Egghead 17
episodes.title: The Five Elders
episodes.description: At the time of the Reverie, Wapol overheard something he shouldn't have and fled the Holy Land with an unlikely partner. On the heels of these events, Imu ordered the Five Elders to test a devastating weapon engineered by Dr. Vegapunk!

episodes.label: Egghead 18
episodes.title: The Final Lesson
episodes.description: At Pirate Island, Vice Admiral Garp continues the Koby extraction mission, but Avalo Pizarro's devil fruit powers threaten to sink the rescue ship. Garp, weakened from an attack by Shiryu, entrusts the operation's success to the next generation.

episodes.label: Egghead 19
episodes.title: Hostage Situation
episodes.description: In the Labophase on Egghead, which is completely surrounded by the Marines, Luffy and the others devise a plan to escape the island. However, the Frontier Dome, the laser defense system, cannot be deactivated without York’s secret passcode.

episodes.label: Egghead 20
episodes.title: Sentomaru
episodes.description: Admiral Kizaru finally makes landfall, but Sentomaru stands in his way while the Straw Hats attempt to move the Sunny to the back side of the island. And back at Mary Geoise, Fleet Admiral Akainu stands in the way of the ever-advancing Kuma.

episodes.label: Egghead 21
episodes.title: Luffy vs. Kizaru
episodes.description: Luffy faces off in a spectacular aerial battle against Admiral Kizaru, but this time, Straw Hat is 100 times stronger than before. Unbeknownst to those on Egghead, something ominous is about to make an appearance on the island...
